title: Dangerous bc metal not properly coated! Rough edges!
text: Where to begin?  I’ve been trying to get the 20 pics of these eyesores to upload since I received them, but they won’t. I ordered them bc one of my service dogs had emergency surgery & both pups were exposed to weed killer my LL put down, but I was unaware of & both pups became ill.  I knew when they arrived that I should have immediately returned them bc both boxes had the look about them that they were someone else’s previous returns.  The bad tape jobs on the boxes are generally a pretty good indicator imo. Both kennels had been placed together in one larger box for shipping so they should neither of them have had such a horrific tape job applied to them. I’ve purchased Midwest kennels for over 35 years & I’ve never purchased them with this kind of tape job in my life.  These were not “factory sealed”.  These hasd obviously been opened & returned. Worse- it looked as tho someone kept the new kennel & returned their old one bc you can literally see where all the powder coating is missing on these kennels which happens over time from use & friction.  One piece in particular has no coating on it whatsoever as can be seen in the photos that won’t load. Lol.  I thought I was buying direct from the manufacturer this time as I’ve moved away from buying from third party sellers due to receiving items like these kennels.  What’s annoying is I desperately needed this for a dog post surgery & im left with an un-safe kennel.  The metal is jagged throughout. I’ve cut my own hands numerous times bc the costing is missing & the metal is bare & rough.  Either the quality of Midwest has taken a nosedive in the 4 yrs since I last purchased a kennel or someone sent me used items.  I cannot recommend this item bc it is dangerous to ur pups eyes, nose, skin, paws, fur, etc.  jagged edges have no business near animal nor human bodies.

The price is great until you realize you either have to return the entire thing which I am planning to do or you have to find new bolts and take the leash apart and install the new ones. They have a stupid little twisted wire thingy like ink pens do. Useless.  My grandson loves the leash. The color is pretty and the lime green makes it easy to find in a house filled with 4 kids under 8 and kids toys and dog toys everywhere.  I literally bought it because we can never seem to find the other leashes before we risk an accident!  Said grandson likes to play with them/lose them/ hide them no matter how well you think you organized them the last time you put them up!  It’s sad that this really is a quality piece for a great price except for those stupid bolts!!! Argh!  The price of new bolts and the pain in the butt it will be to replace them means I may as well return it and hope I can find an exact duplicate to repurchase.  With different bolts it would definitely be 5 Stars!

title: As always, ruffwear delivers
text:
In my experience ruffwear is always top of the line when it comes to dog products, and this pouch is no exception. I clipped a clicker to the clicker loop, added a few plastic bags to the outside pocket (clicker can still be tucked inside) and filled it with treats... I take it with me on every walk to reward good behavior such as loose leash walking, heeling, looking away from squirrels, etc and use it for clicker training sessions at home.

The bag is contoured to fit against the curve of my hip and can be bent/adjusted. The small red tab on the outside and magnetic closure mean it can be operated with one hand. The bag closes securely. I love that the clip where it atatches to my pants is in the middle of the bag, not above it as with many other models. The bad is securely attached and does not wobble or sway. I don't use the included red belt, but it's very nice and will be useful with dresses, etc.

However the center part of the bed is very thin - about 1/2" and does not provide a comfortable amount of padding. I put an additional clothes cell phone pad underneath the bed to make it more comfortable for him. This is a strange thing to overlook because the main point of the bed is that it should be comfortable for a pet to lay on while they're in the crate! An inch to 2 inches of potting seems to be the norm.

title: Great reflective harness!
text: I ordered this product to have  a reflective, high visibility harness for road running with my dog. WOW this delivers. Very very visible, the front section has a lot of reflective materials and the rest has reflective stitching. The yellow is very bright. It fits him well (28" chest, ordered size L) and I can connect it to his collar for extra security. There is a front and a back clip and the buckles appear sturdy.

title: Good safety device for might walks.

title: In between sizes, got a large daypack for 27" girth 50lb dog, he loves it
text:
My dog has a 27" girth and I was not sure if he needed a medium or a large, I got a size large. The straps are designed so that they can be tightened all the way, so it was easy to tighten them down to his size. We got it recently but it seems very durable and well made, I'll update if we have any problems. The pockets are large enough to hold 2 standard disposable water bottles (16.9 oz or 500 ml) per side or a single 750 mL reusable water bottle. Weight wise this is probably the max that my dog can carry (it would be about 5lbs or 10% of his body weight). The pockets do seem big and roomy though!

I decided not to use the attachment ring on the harness because it destabilizes the load when my dog moves about. I clipped the leash to his collar instead. I think having a pack gives him a "job" and he walked very nicely with it on so this was not a problem. I would not recommend using this item for a dog who pulls strongly as it may slip around.

title: Great long leash for training, exploring, and play
text: Beautiful leash! A bit hard to manage at first but you get the hang of it. My dog loved having so much space to run and play. I took him to a big empty area to work on recall, play fetch, run and sniff, etc. You'll want to use one hand to hold excess line and one to keep the leash off the ground so your dog doesn't trip. You can also clip the end to your belt for security. I also recommend using a harness so your dog won't be putting pressure on his neck. We had a great time though and my hyper, high energy pooch wore himself out safely without the risks of letting him run off leash in a public place. The leash has beautiful bright colors and is very sturdy and well made.

title: Good for attaching to leash
text: I keep this dispenser stretched to our leash handle and it works great. The clip for a full bag also works great. It's really convenient to have everything together because I can just grab it and go, no more hunting around for a bag or dealing with a roll unwinding in my pocket. I use the Velcro strap to attach it to a metal ring on the leash handle. You could also use the Velcro to attach directly to the handle.

title: Nice harness
text:
I just got this harness and it's already so much better than the ones we've tried on in person. My dog is a 55lb year old mix with a deep chest and narrow neck/shoulders and other harnesses didn't fit well. He measured for a medium and it fits well after we adjusted the harness (measure your dog!). The front clip discourages pulling and makes walks easy and fun. Back clip doesn't prevent pulling but my dog doesn't seem to know this and pulls less whenever the harness is on just in case it might pull him sideways. The loop on the top is useful to grab my dog as needed or while changing the leash attachment point. We've also used the car attachment a few times and he settles right down to lay down in the back seat.

My dog loves the harness and gets excited when I bring it out, so I assume it's comfortable. Looks well made and durable. The reflective stitching is really bright. I think this is much more comfortable for my dog than waking with a collar and it's more comfortable for me because I don't have to manage a large dog who is pulling me around. He is much calmer and better behaved with this harness so I really enjoy our walks.

title: Nice way to camoflauge the litter!
text: This is a nice little shelter to cover the cat litter box. It was easy to put together. Not the most quality of plastic, if I was looking for something very attractive to match quality furnishings, this might not be it. In all fairness, my current litter box was too large for this so I needed to buy a newer, smaller one. So, if you are looking for something to house an extra large box, look elsewhere. Price is good, better than having nothing around the litter.

title: Great biodegradable poop bags!
text: These are great biodegradable poop bags. I carry them with me in the handy dispenser and have been using them for a few weeks now. I love how easy they are to open (sometimes these bags are sticky and you can't get the open) and how strong they are. And, I especially love to know they are biodegradable so I am not messing up the environment with any more non-biodegradable waste. This is a large set, too, which will last me for months. Highly recommend!

title: Great brush for my Roxie
text: In fairness, I do not have a labradoodle. I have an aussie shepherd mix dog who has super long hair and is a terrible shedder. I love this brush. First, it fits well in my hand and allows maneuverability easy. Second, it collects the hair thoroughly and after a single brushing, I have to clean the brush as it is full (so it does a great job of collecting loose hair). Last, my Roxie really likes it and I am sure she loves the way it feels when I brush her and the attention she is receiving. I definitely see a difference in shedded hair around my house after using this for almost a month now. Highly recommend to anyone who has a longer haired dog.

title: Love, love, love this pet stroller!
text: I absolutely love this stroller! My small dog (poodle mix) fits in here great (around 9 pounds). This was fairly easy to put together (I am usually technically challenged so that says a lot!). It is well made and my dog just loves it! I love that I can also take it with me for use in the car. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a pet stroller.

title: Great for short and midlength hair on dogs
text: I have a dog who is a constant shedder, so I find myself vacuuming constantly. I did want to try this and I will say that it is an ok brush and comb set for short to mid-length fur dogs. My aussie shepherd has longer hair and a bushy tail and this set just didn't really do it. I mean, it did make a difference on her fur in that it took off some of the top coat, but it didn't reach into her thicker hair areas. It does have a variety of tools and I will use this on my short haired cat going forward, but it just wasn't right for my dog.

title: Bad reviews and my Roxie wouldn't even try one
text: When I ordered these I hadn't checked the reviews. If I did, I certainly wouldn't have ordered. I do know that some of these really horrible one star reviews are three years old. So, with all the recent better reviews I figured I would let my dog (7 year old aussie shepherd mix) try one. She snubbed her nose at this and wouldn't even try it. So, I threw away the bag. Again, just reading some of the older reviews I didn't want to try again and force the issue. Can't recommend.

title: Roxie gives these 4 paws up!
text: My dog (Aussie Shepherd) loves all Good n Fun products. She loves the ability to chew on them and I love that they don't contain rawhide. This was a new variety for me and I wasn't quite sure what to expect. Well, as usual, she gleefully grabbed the first one I pulled out of the bag and ran off to enjoy it. These are a high quality and sometimes to me seem a little expensive, but it is so worth it when I see how much my pup loves them. Highly recommend!

title: Best pet carrier in the market today!
text: I have always used hard-sided carriers for my cat which tend to be bulky and difficult to store. I really was interested in trying a soft-sided one and I am glad I did! This is light weight and foldable so if you need to store it you can easily. Quality made, it assembles easily and has zippers that move smoothly and do not snag. My cat is eleven pounds and I got the larger size to give her a little more room and it works great for her. I highly recommend this soft sided pet carrier.

title: Great chew treat for a larger dog
text: My dog loves the Good N Fun products, so when I saw this new variety, I had to try it. Unfortunately, these are too big for her (she is a 32 lb. Aussie Shepherd mix). She did take it from me immediately, but it was too big for her to chew on.  I ended up trying them on a friend's German Shepherd and he actually loved these (went off in to a corner to work on it for a while). Anyway, while I can't recommend them for smaller dogs (like my Roxie), I can attest that the bigger dogs who love to chew will love these. Highly recommend.

title: Roxie gives these two paws up!
text: My 6 year old aussie shepherd mix is typically a picky eater, but she absolutely loves these! They are not too large and satisfy her chewing urge. I know she really likes them as she begs for them when she sees the bag. These are a great alternative to rawhide and they are good for her, too. Highly recommend!

title: My dog loves these and they are good for her teeth as well!
text: These are a great alternative to Greenies (and at a more reasonable price). I have a large (65 lb) active Irish Setter and she loves to chew. She really likes these as a treat (give her one a day) and she will spend time happily chewing it. They do seem to keep some tartar off her teeth as well. She takes the larger size and she really enjoys them. Highly recommend for the dog you love!

title: Never mind
text: Never signed up so I really can't review this. Didn't realize when I ordered this I would need to pay for a subscription. I love my dog but I really don't need to know her level of activity given she is relatively young (5 years old) and very active. Perhaps if you have an older/heavier dog and your veterinarian is recommending a program of exercise, then I think this would be worthwhile having.

title: My cat didn't like them, but yours may
text: First, I have to say that I purchase Rachel Ray products for my dog (she loves them). However, when it comes to my 14 year old cat, she will only eat Fancy Feast products (wet and dry) and Temptations for treats. I tried her, at least on 6 different occasions on these, and she snubbed her nose every time on them and never touched one. My dog, on the other hand, loved them, lol, and cleaned up the couple of treats when the cat wouldn't eat them. So, although the quality of these is great, I really can't recommend them based on my own finicky cat's experience with them.

title: Has everything you need
text: I got this set up for my grandsons who were looking to get a hamster. What a great cage and larger than I expected. Has everything that you need when first getting your pet, so no need to have to purchase items separately.  It also was super easy to assemble and within minutes we were ready to use. Highly recommend this cage package for any small animal (mice, hamsters, guinea pigs, etc).

title: Make sure it's for a small or toy sized dog
text: This is a small dog toy. My 32 lb. Aussie Shepherd mix liked it and immediately took it from me when I opened the package. I am deducting two stars first because the squeaker was minimal (hard to activate and low to hear, had to keep pressing the toy body in different ways to try to get it to squeak). Secondly, within a day I found the little bow was off the toy and on the floor and I also see parts of the doll fading (from the dog saliva). I threw it out because I didn't want her to swallow any of this. Maybe if you have a toy sized dog this would work for you, but it wasn't great for my dog.

title: Lucy likes this, but portion size is very small
text: To begin with, my cat is a super finicky eater. Will only eat Fancy Feast regular canned food and then it either has to be grilled or sliced (will not touch the pate). Anyway, she really liked this packet Fancy Feast and has tried all the varieties now. I am deducting a star just because the portion size is small and it is not enough to feed her. I end up opening this along with either a regular can or sometimes opening two. Not sure why these portions are so small. Anyway, she really did like this, just not enough of it per portion.

title: My cat didn't like the pate variety
text: My Lucy loves Fancy Feast and eats a can each morning. Typically, I buy the grilled or sliced varieties, so I wasn't sure how she would do with a pate. She honestly went to it immediately, licked around it and eventually left it alone. I used a fork to break it up a bit, but it didn't seem to make a difference. I am rating this as 4 stars because I think it's my finicky cats way of eating and should not be considered a problem with the product.

title: Dog loved them!
text: My 55 lb. golden just loved these. From the second I opened the package, Murphy grabbed the first 'bone' and happily ran off with it. She finished it rather quickly, though. Don't look to these as a long time gnawing bone, but more as a treat. Upon finishing the first one, she came back for the second one. Although she really loved these, I will only be buying them for special treats since they would be too costly for a couple of times a day treat.

title: Super absorbent!
text: Another great Amazon brand product! I love Solimo brand as you get the same quality as name brand items and a fraction of the cost. These puppy pee pads are super absorbent and work well. I don't particularly care for this smaller size as my dog is 35 lbs and usually will need a longer one, but I put two of these next to each other and they work just as well. I highly recommend these for anyone who is training their dog and can't always be home to take their dog out.

title: Might be alright for others, my Lucy wouldn't eat it
text: This might work for others, but my 13 year old calico just wouldn't touch this. I tried it three different times, even tried mixing in some moist food and she just snubbed her nose at it. She does tend to be a little on the finicky side so I rated it at 3 stars in case your cat would eat it. To be honest, I also have a dog who also didn't try to eat it (she has a tendency to hit the cat's food once in a while out of spite). So, if the cat (and the dog) wouldn't eat this then I can't recommend. Sorry.

title: When it was up, it worked great, however tape wouldn't hold for long
text: I have a cat who loves to scratch furniture, despite all the scratching posts I have around my house for her to use. I was thrilled to see this and couldn't wait to try it. Well, for the pluses, it is easy to apply and the fact that it's clear is hard to detect that you have it up. The problem I had with this is that the tape didn't stick well and within a couple of days I found myself putting additional tape (which was visible) to help it stick. I eventually removed it. This may work better on doors or wood or metal, but on cloth it didn't work well (for me anyway).

title: My Lucy absolutely loves this!
text: I was wondering if my typically finicky feline would like this. This is a new flavor for her (quail) and I didn't know if she would eat it. Surprisingly, she gobbled down most of the can in the first eating. She also usually doesn't like the pates as much as sliced or chopped varieties. So, when I saw her eating this, I knew she must really like this. I love Purina products and although she usually eats Fancy Feast, this new Purina Beyond is definitely a higher quality and is grain free. I will be buying more and trying other varieties. Highly recommend.

title: Great lightweight litter!!
text: I love Tidy Cats Litter and especially this Lightweight variety. I am a 60 something year old woman and sometimes carrying those 30+ lb litter boxes can be difficult (especially when it comes to pouring). Purina lightweight makes it so much easier. This variety also clumps well, does not track and makes litter cleanup time a breeze. I probably would have liked this better in a plastic container instead of a box for ease, but for greenwise purposes, this is a great product all around. Highly recommend!

title: Food was ok (my Lucy liked it), pouch was awkward and wasteful
text: My cat (a 12 year old finicky calico) typically won't eat anything but a few brands of cat food. I was pleasantly surprised to see that she liked it (or at least she ate it). My problem with this is the pouch instead of a can. I cut open the pouch and squeezed it out but got some on my hands and then it was difficult getting all of it out. I am not sure why vendors use pouches they are just difficult to open and empty. Won't be buying any more of the pouches.

title: Nice quality grain-free dog snack, took a bit for my dog to like them
text: I tried a few varieties of this Purina Beyond biscuit snacks on my dog Roxie. She is a 32 lb. Aussie Shepherd mix dog who does tend to be a little picky when it comes to food and snacks. At first, she wasn't crazy about these and kind of snubbed her nose at them (which is why I deducted a star). However, when she realized she wouldn't be getting any other snacks, she did start eating them and once she did it seemed like she began to like them more. Not sure if it was the texture or the tasted but she was reluctant to aggressively be eating these. These are grain free and a quality snack so I do recommend them for your dog. I will continue to give these to her because I know they are a good treat for her.

title: Great protection for your furniture from your pets at a great price!
text: I have to start by saying the dog in my life that I love dearly (5 year old Aussie Shephard mix) is a terrible shedder. All she has to do is walk past me and almost like the Peanut's character Pig Pen, Roxie sheds a bunch of her fur all over the place. She also is a tad spoiled rotten and sits anywhere she likes (including my furniture). I have this cover on her favorite sofa and use it daily. It's a wonderful fit and drapes over the material well and protects my furniture well. I also have a cat and she will actually sit up on this sofa as well with the dog. This is super easy to clean, just throw it in the washing machine and dryer and it looks like new. Highly recommend!

title: Another great Fancy Feast product!
text: My 12 year old finicky eater calico cat eats almost exclusively Fancy Feast products (wet and dry). Flavors are great, texture and size of the morsels are perfect for her. This chicken variety is one of her favorites and I keep her dish filled with it all the time (to eat when the urge hits). I have had no troubles with UTIs or anything else since she has been eating this. I love that I can give her a food that she loves that is good for her as well. Of course, this is not quite as good as boutique brand foods (health-wise) but she loves this and I am happy to give her what she will eat.

title: A great grain free dog food, my Roxie loves it!
text: I love most Purina products. Maybe not always the best quality when compared to all natural more expensive boutique brands, but I always keep some around to add or supplement my dog's normal daily food. She (5 year old Aussie Shepherd mix) loves this Purina Beyond chicken variety. I add it to her Blue Buffalo kibble and she gobbles down every last piece. She is typically a very picky eater and also prone to allergies, so this grain free variety is perfect for her. I highly recommend for any allergy prone dogs or just dogs who may be finicky eaters as I know they will love this.

title: Great gravy lovers variety is one of my cats new favorites!
text: My 13 year old calico (Lucy) has always preferred Fancy Feast over any other cat foods in the market (both moist and dry varieties). This new chicken gravy lovers variety was no exception. Upon opening the can, she immediately began eating and finished almost the entire can. I know that Fancy Feast may not be the most nutritious food in the market today, but I know at least my always finicky eater will finish her food when her meal time comes. Highly recommend for the finicky cat in your home.

title: Flavor was good, pate was of no interest to my feline
text: My 13 year old calico (Lucy) has always preferred Fancy Feast over any other cat foods in the market (both moist and dry varieties). However, she tends to prefer the grilled or chopped varieties instead of the pate variety. Upon opening the can, she immediately began eating but stopped about 25% of the way through. She always has had difficulty or at least it appeared that way, eating chunk food. So, although the flavor was good to her (as evidenced by her immediately trying it), the texture did not hold her attention for very long. I am only deducting one star since I am sure there are other cats out there that might really like it (it's just my finicky eater).

title: Another home run for Purina!
text: My 13 year old calico (Lucy) has always preferred Fancy Feast over any other cat foods in the market (both moist and dry varieties). This new coconut infused was no exception. Upon opening the can, she immediately began eating and finished almost the entire can. I know that Fancy Feast may not be the most nutritious food in the market today, but I know at least my always finicky eater will finish her food when her meal time comes. Highly recommend for the finicky cat in your home.

title: Great brush perfect for all dogs
text: This is a really nice dog brush. I have an Aussie Shepherd/Border Collie mix who is a terrible shedder. I try to brush her at least once or twice a day to keep the loose hair under control (it's a never ending battle). This brush is great. Easy to hold in my hand and maneuver, the bristles collect all her hair and with a simple pull, I can clean the brush almost immediately. She loves the brushing as well, the bristles must feel great, too. I can highly recommend this brush to anyone with a dog (especially one who sheds like my Roxie).

title: Really nice dog harness for the money
text: Nice dog harness. Only reason why I am deducting a star is because even though I measured my dog, this harness (large) fits my dog a little too snugly (she is a 36 lbs Aussie Shepherd mix). I should have sized up on for this to fit optimally. This is well made, sturdy and seems really comfortable for dogs. I like that my dog no longer is getting 'choked' as she would on a regular leash and collar when she would pull. Highly recommend for your dog, just be sure that if you are close to the top of the measurement chart you go up a size to fit properly.

title: Great portable fence but super heavy
text: I live in a new community where they do not allow fences on our properties. This causes a dilemma for me with my dog as I love to sit outside and sun during the day and relax at night. My poor dog used to sit inside and watch me from behind my screen door. When I found this I was thrilled as I thought I could use it to allow my Roxie to enjoy the outside as much as I do. I did find this fairly easy to assemble and it will stand up to her repeatedly knocking up against it. Where I had trouble was in taking it down easily and storing it. This is heavy and not easy for my 60 something body to easily move around. Please be sure you have some upper body strength before you assume this is 'portable'.

title: Great chew with good ingredients, my dog did not like the salmon flavor
text: Rating these as 4 stars. My dog (5 years old) did not like them although I tried them many times. They smell fishy and so my assumption is the flavor is as well. My dog tends to be a meat eater (and leaves the fish flavors for the cat in my house) so maybe that's why she wouldn't eat it. Anyway, it is worth the 4 stars because of the ingredients and that it may just be that my dog is a super picky eater.

title: Great tasting chew that my dog loves, chock full of daily necessary nutrients
text: These chews are a great way to give your dogs the Omega fatty acids and nutrients they need. My 5 year aussie shepherd mix loves them and gobbles it up just like she would a treat. These contain vitamin E, fish and flax seed oil and biotin all of which are necessary for your dog's skin and overall health. I give one every day to my Roxie and her coat is more gorgeous than ever and I have even noticed she seems to be shedding less as well. I highly recommend for the dog in your life that you love.

title: My Roxie really loves this toy!
text: Great dog play for my 5 year old Aussie Shepherd mix puppy. First, it's pretty big (or at least bigger than I thought it would be). It's actually comical watching her carrying it around with her 32 lb body frame with the legs dangling. She loves the squeaky noise it makes and it is pretty durably made which makes it good for her when she starts her chewing. Highly recommend as a kind of unique dog toy. Your dog will think they had gone hunting and caught the big one! Roxie has not put it down since I gave it to her a few weeks ago and I love it!

title: Great quality dog food - despite my dog's pickiness
text: I have a 6 year old Aussie Shepherd mix dog who is infamously a picky eater. And, as expected, she kind of half-heartedly has been eating this food. I am rating it 4 star as it is, as most of the Hill's Science Diet products, a great quality dog food. Most dogs would love it, but my Roxie will take time. She has eaten it partially probably because I have mixed it with some moist food and cooked meats, but she is eating it.  I recommend this to owners of dogs who are not quite as picky as Roxie as I am sure they will love it.

title: Great natural treats that my Roxie loves!
text: These are perfect treats for my 35 lb Aussie Shepherd mix 5 year old dog. First, they are the perfect size for her (not too small but not overly large for her). Second, they are grain free which really helps her because of her skin allergies. Third, they have no artificial flavors, fillers or preservatives and they contain real chicken, vegetables and fruit. She loves them because they taste good, I love them because they are good for her. I highly recommend these biscuits to anyone who loves their dog!

title: Great rawhide free chews that my dog loves!
text: These are one of my 5 year old Aussie Shepherd mixes treats. She loves walking around with them in her mouth and eventually settling down to a good chew session. I love that they are rawhide free (which my veterinarian told me was imperative for her health). And, they are Milk Bone products which assures some of the highest level of quality in the pet food and treat industry today. Highly recommend them for the dog you love in your life!

title: My picky dog does not like these
text: I don't know why my dog (Roxie) doesn't like these. I have been trying them on and off for the past few years seeing how all the other reviewers here have dogs who love them. Roxie will get excited when I get the bag and rip it open and she will even readily take it from me and run off. But, just a few minutes later, I will find it sitting in another room untouched. I can't recommend it simply because it's not for my dog (5 year old Aussie Shepherd) but maybe your dog will love them.

title: Great food for your cat, chock full of goodness
text: Great cat food which my Lucy actually likes (she typically is very fussy and only wants to eat Fancy Feast). I like that there are no fillers and that the first ingredient is meat (so much better than the FF I usually have to feed her). I am not deducting a star as it's probably not fair to the brand, but I really don't like these foods that come in pouches. It is often difficult to get all the food out of the pouch easily and I end up shaking and squeezing to try to get it all out. I really wish they would have used either cans or the plastic containers.

title: My dog wouldn't touch these
text: In fairness to other dogs, my Roxie is a super picky eater. However, she usually runs to get treats (especially those which are chewable). Not sure why, but she really didn't like these. I tried her on three of them at three different times and she would take them but immediately drop them. Maybe it's the fish flavor (although she does eat my cat's food if I don't watch her)? But I can't recommend these to anyone simply because she wouldn't try them at all.

title: My dog loves these dog treats!
text: My dog absolutely loved these, and honestly saying that is a lot. She typically is picky and snubs her nose at most things (with the exception of some human foods). When I first got these I was skeptical, but surprisingly she loved these and begged for more. If there is any complaint (and there is none really) it's that these are all pieces of different sizes and they do crumble easily. I wish they were in a little larger size so I don't have to feed her some pieces which are almost like crumbs. Not sure if it comes this way or whether it's just the way this one package came to me. I like pieces I can hand to her which she can take one at a time. Anyway, outside of that, I (and my Roxie) loves these.

title: Great all natural dog food, my Roxie really likes it
text: My typically picky 5 year old aussie shepherd mix really liked this dog food. And, in looking at the quality ingredients, I was thrilled to be able to give it to her. Meat as the first listed ingredient, it looks like it's all natural, no artificial colors, I love being able to give my dog meat she craves while being sure she gets the nutrition she needs. I find this comparable to Blue Buffalo but at a lesser cost.

title: Didn't really work for me with my dog, but results may not be typical
text: I don't know really how to rate these. I mean they are made by Bissell, and I love Bissell products. But, they didn't work for me. I have an almost 35 lb Aussie Shepherd/ Border Collie mix who sheds like crazy (long hairs). I tried these gloves several times on her. Unlike other gloves I have used, my dog didn't really care for the feel (some others I have tried are a great massage feel for her, these evidently don't). And when it came to removing the fur, I didn't see the glove catching and holding her hair. I am rating these as three stars because it seems like everyone else here really loved these. I am thinking (hoping) that it may just be the texture and consistency of her fur which may be the issue. Please don't take my review as typical, please be sure to read the rest of the reviews to get a good idea if these will work for you.

title: Great efficient litter box!
text: This is a great, attractive, cat litter box. It is big enough to allow my cat Lucy plenty of room. It is quality made and will stand up to repeated unfastening and fastening the top for solid cleanings. I can't testify to the two entrances for the cat, mine won't use the top one. This is super easy to clean and the way it is built, it minimizes the tracking of litter out of the box and onto the floor. I really like this Pakeway litter box and highly recommend it.

title: Great quality made seat cover!
text: This is an absolutely perfect front passenger seat cover for my Toyota Camry. First, it's a great quality and strong enough to stand up for years of my dogs nails and abuse, lol. Second, it fits great, no slip and stays in place even with my dog jumping in and out of the car. Third, it really protects my seat and is waterproof (great for when my dog drools from the heat). No complaints, just kudos. This is a great seat cover!

title: My Roxie loves these
text: I wasn't sure if my typically picky 5 year old Aussie Shepherd mix puppy would like these. But, surprisingly, she took the first one happily (going off into a corner to eat it and quickly returning for more). I love Hills Science Diet products for my dog and I know they are made with the finest ingredients. These biscuits are made with real chicken and she absolutely loves them and on top of it all they are considered 'light' for those dogs looking to watch their caloric intake (without sacrificing flavor or texture). Try them, I am sure your dog will love them too.

title: Good quality dog chew
text: My finicky Aussie-Shepherd 5 year old dog is so-so about these. She initially snubbed her nose at it and wouldn't touch it. Later on, I saw her chewing on it and eventually finished it. I have tried these at least 1/2 a dozen times since and it's been the same result. Typically, when she likes something she goes for it immediately and eats it. I like these because they are not rawhide (a big plus) and it contains all natural ingredients. I am deducting a star as my pup just really doesn't go bonkers for them.

title: Not my idea of a dog brush
text: I didn't care for this Dexas Popware brush. I have a 5 year old Aussie Shephard mix who sheds like crazy. When I saw this, I thought I would try it. I did not find that it cured the shedding problem I have. On the positive side, the brush fits well in my hand and is easy to control. On the negative side, it's made of rubber. The 'teeth' are too thick and don't pick up the finer hairs (only the long ones). Anyway, I will stick with my traditional brushes which are wire based and will grab and hold all the loose hairs on her.

title: Great litter mat, gets it all
text: Quality nice sized litter mat. My 8 year old cat Lucy usually makes a mess of her litter after she visits 'the box' but with this mat, she is no longer tracking litter in my laundry room area. Litter stays on the mat and with a dustbuster, cleans up  flawlessly. Highly recommend this for anyone with a messy kitty like mine.

title: My Lucy is in love!
text: I typically allow my cat to play with catnip toys. I wasn't quite used to buying catnip loose like this. I was wondering what I could do with this and I was pleasantly surprised. My 12 year old cat Lucy went crazy for this. I sprinkled a little on the floor at first and she began to roll in it and sniff and I swear she was acting like a kitten all over again. Next I started sprinkling it on her scratching post which actual attracted her to the post and now has her using it more now more than in the past (my furniture thanks you, lol). This is a fresh product and in a convenient resealable package. Highly recommend this for any kitties that you love!

title: Great all natural treat that my dog really loves!
text: My Roxie absolutely loves these. Typically very picky in her eating, my 5 year old Aussie Shepherd mix normally snubs her nose at anything new. To my surprise, after a quick smell, she readily ate the treat out of my hand and actually begged immediately for more (which of course I gave her). These Dreambone treats are all natural and I love giving them to her. If there was any complaint at all, it is the size of the treats. I guess they are meant more for miniature dog breeds, but I give her a couple at a time to make up for it.

title: Good reasonably priced cat litter
text: This is an average cat litter (do not consider it 'premium'). When comparing it to my normal litter (primarily Tidy Cat), I didn't find this Cat Love as good at clumping as TC (which is why I deducted a star). That said, I do find this is a cheaper alternative (26 lbs for less than $9 as of today) than the store bought options (and Amazon will deliver it 'free' with Prime to my door).

title: Cat tried it, but didn't use it again. Might work for others.
text: I was so excited when I saw these. My cat desperately needs cat scratchers in my house (corrugated) because I need to keep her away from my furniture. Unfortunately, my cat just wouldn't use these. I think the corrogated feature is too tight  and she couldn't get a good enough grip to use it. Also think she didn't like the fact that these are flat (and not in a wedge). I ended up taking it away when I saw her heading for my rug to scratch and replaced it with her old standby wedge shaped. Sorry, but didn't work for my feline.

title: Great harness, works really well on my dog
text: This is a great harness for my almost 40 lb Aussie Shepherd mix dog. It fits her perfectly is padded so she doesn't get irritated and is attractive.  This was the first time I used a harness on her and surprisingly she adopted to it quickly. It was easy to put on and take off and I love the fact that I am no longer 'pulling' her by her neck collar when I want to guide her along. Great harness for your needs, just be sure you measure your dog to assure you get the optimum size.

title: Great natural grain-free treats my Roxie loves!
text: My dog absolutely loves these. And I love that it is a grain free and mostly natural ingredient treat. Turkey and chicken are her favorite treats and she loves to chew. Medium is a great size for her 35 lb. body (I tried the larger, but she didn't take to them as well).

title: Good treat, dog loves them, but only interested in the outer flavors and loses interest thereafter

It did keep her busy for a while, but then I noticed she left the bare bone after she took off the outer bacon. Although, I have continued to give them to her (hate to waste the bag), it is a shame that these mini-bones will not keep my dog happy beyond the first 20 minutes. 4 stars, can't give these a 5

text: All in all, this is a good dog treat. With no wheat, soy, corn or preservatives, I would feel confident in feeding them to my 4 year old Aussie Shepherd mix Roxie. Unfortunately, she didn't like them. Maybe the fact that these are cranberry/oat variety and not something with chicken or beef, turned her away. However, you can't judge the quality of this product by my dog as she has a tendency to be very picky when it comes to any food. I have read other reviews here and I see that most dogs love these, so I am rating them as 4 stars simply based on the quality of the product and its ingredients.

title: Great dog bed, my Roxie gives it 4 paws up!
text: This is a great dog bed. Great size for my 35 lb. dog, super comfy and my dog loves it. I keep her inside, so that is where the bed is (I can't vouch for how they will work outside).  Nice quality, attractive and well priced. I have owned and have been happy with other Pet Craft products and I am pleased with this one as well.

title: Super good quality dog food, unfortunately my dog didn't like it
text: This is a great dog food. Filled with quality ingredients and no artificial colors, flavors or fillers, this is a nutritious way to feed your dogs. I did deduct a star for this because my dog just wouldn't eat it. I have tried four times and have even mixed it with moist foods and she has picked it over. Don't judge the product on my dog's reaction as she does tend to be super picky. I would suggest you try it (as other reviews out here are very positive).

title: Great dog chews that my Roxie just loves!
text: My typically picky eater, 4 year old Aussie Shepherd mix, loves these jerky dog treats. And I love giving them to her! title: Decent dog food, great quality, my dog wouldn't eat it
text: Ok, so it is a great quality. No artificial colors or ingredients. Meat is listed as the first ingredient. Problem is my 4 year old picky Aussie Shepherd mix wouldn't eat it. I know it is the consistency more than anything as she tends to like her food in pieces with consistency similar to human food. This is too thick and chunky and if I didn't like the fragrance I am sure she didn't like it either. This did not go to waste, I ended up donating it to my local animal rescue league.

title: Great variety pack of dog treats and chews - if your dog likes them all
text: I liked this because of the variety in the pack. All shapes, sizes and varieties of dog chews. I am deducting a star simply because my Aussie-shepherd mix dog didn't care for two of them (the longer stick variety). Anyway, going forward, I will purchase the ones she likes so I can be sure to use the entire package (and not have to throw away the ones she rejects). This may work for your dogs, but to me it was a waste to have only some interest her.

title: Not 100% sure of the effectiveness of this
text: I recently sold my house of 15 years and moved into a temporary apartment until my newly constructed home will be completed in September 2018. As I have a skittlsh 11 year old female cat, I was wondering how she would handle the stress of the packing and moving, the car ride north and adjusting into her new locations. I plugged this into one of the outlets in my new home a day ahead of my moving her there. As expected, it wasn't an easy experience for her overall. She fought me getting into her cage and when I when I got her to the new house she disappeared under one of the beds for the better of two days. I am not sure if this really worked or not so I am rating it three stars. I will say that when she finally did resurface out of the new bedroom she did seem to adjust quickly to her new environment. I did not like the fragrance of this unit and I was thrilled to be able to unplug it. Rating it as three stars as I am up in the air on this. Not sure if I am going to use this when I begin the next part of my move in September.

title: Great morsel dog food that my fussy puppy will gladly eat!
text: I have a super fussy eater in my soon to be 5 years old Aussie Shepherd pup Roxie. She rarely eats much more than treats, table food and cheese (except if she can get to the cat's food, lol). I never expected her to like this so I cautiously tried it with her and I was amazingly surprised. She really liked this. I think it's probably the texture (she likes food which is in bite size morsel sizes and not pates or traditional canned foods). I like this because I know Pedigree makes a good quality dog food (although maybe not the best in the market) and I don't mind feeding this to her. I am just happy to see her eating dog food again. Kudos Pedigree!

title: Great cat treats now available in a convenient larger size variety pack!
text: My 11 year old cat, Lucy, has been 'addicted' to Temptations treats for years now. I love this new larger size variety pack. It makes it much more convenient, and cheaper, for me to buy the larger size variety packs. All of her favorites (especially the turkey) are in this box. Nothing but great things to say about these treats as she loves all the varieties and now that it is available in the larger size, both of us are thrilled!

title: Too big for my dog, might work well for others
text: Way too big for my 35 lb. Aussie Shepherd, I honestly thought, when I opened the package, that I was opening something that came from Jurassic Park, lol. Anyway, my dog snubbed her nose at this. I thought maybe she would at least make an attempt to lick or do something with it, but she had no interest. I ended up giving it to my next door neighbor's dog (a full size bulldog mix) who did seem to enjoy it. It did break up as he gnawed on this and I am not sure if that could present a choking hazard for some dogs. Please be sure your dog is large enough to handle this before ordering. I would say 80+ lbs for a dog for sure.

title: My dog did not like these

She does have a tendency to be a picky eater, but she usually does like chews and Greenies, so I thought she might at least try them. I can't recommend them at all. Had to toss them. Sorry.

title: Soft and cushiony, great bedding for a dog.

title: Great dog bed, my puppy loves it!
text: This is a perfect bed for my 4 year old Aussie Shepherd mix dog. She is 35 lbs and this large size fits her perfectly. Soft and comfortable for her, she loved it from the minute I opened the box. And it is easy to clean. As an fyi, I don't crate my dog so I am using this as a standalone bed. However,  I know that if I used this in a crate it would make crating far more comfortable as well. Because of this, it saves potential damage to my furniture and Roxie absolutely loves this bed. Kudos to MidWest Homes to a great dog bed!

title: Not well made, use caution and read all the reviews out there before purchasing
text: Not a very well made kennel. My dog is a 35 lb mid-size dog and I was honestly afraid she would be able to get out of it. I feel this is a cheaply made kennel and you can do much better out there by spending just a few dollars more.

title: Roxie loves all Pedigree foods, but prefers this roasted chicken variety.
text: For a basic dog food which is readily available almost everywhere, Pedigree makes a great product that my Roxie absolutely loves. title: Best collar on the market today, quality made and fits great!

I can't rate the product as awful, as I know these are great products and I am sure other dogs would be snapping these up like crazy. title: My dog who normally hates traditional dog food, loves Cesar Home Delights!
text: My finicky 4 year old pup typically snubs her nose at traditional 'moist' dog foods (preferring the foods that I, and her feline sister, eat). Since that time, she is steadily eating this Cesar Home Delights on a regular basis. I love the ingredients, the quality and the fact that my dog absolutely prefers this over any other dog food on the market. I am thrilled to have found this!

title: My cat just snubbed her nose at this variety
text: My 12 year old indoor cat, who desperately needs a product like this because of her being prone to hairballs, didn't like this. title: Great rawhide-free chews for the canine in your life!

title: Great rawhide free chews!

title: Great rawhide-free treat for the dog you love!

title: Great, easy to use, pet odor and stain remover
text: My cat recently turned 12 years old.Up until about 6 months ago, I never noticed her having any trouble with the litter box. Easy to use, saturate the carpet and clean.No odors, no stains, is probably one of the best stain removers on the market. title: Great full bodied instand coffee, should be a staple in every pantry!

This coffee is a great alternative to keep on hand for last minute guests or for using on a daily basis when you don't have the time to making a pot of brewed coffee.

text: Typically my 40 lb. Aussie Shepherd mix 4 year old dog loves Dingo products. This variety was not that big a hit for her. I am not sure why, thinking it may have been the size (shaped like a large boomerang) or whether it was the taste or the texture (these are really hard). I am still rating them as 4 stores because I am thinking a larger dog would gravitate to these, but my little female might have been a little intimidated by them. title: Great dog food, great for mixing and in a convenient packet form

Second, it's a seafood variety made with real salmon and all natural ingredients. I am pleasantly surprised by my kitten taking to this new flavor, but I think she is young enough not to have picked some of the finicky habits of her elder 'sister' cat. I feed her 'sister' Hills Diet almost exclusively as well as Hill's seems to know how to create varieties that cats (and kitties) really like.Highly recommend this for the new kitten in your life to get her started on the right food (and away from the 'bad habit' of eating the lesser quality foods later on in life).

text: This is an easy to install pet door. Very small (so please check your measurements carefully prior to purchasing). Highly recommend this for anyone looking for an easy way for their pet to gain exit and entry to their house independently> It doesn't hurt that it is an attractive door as well and looks great in my kitchen. Just please be sure to check the measurements before you buy.

title: Great AmazonBasics harness for the dog you love!
text: This is one of the best dog harnesses on the market today. My almost 40 lb. Aussies Shepherd mix loves her walks and eagerly gets excited whenever we go out. I tend to use an expanding leash when we walk (to allow her some room) and I found myself with her regular leash and collar pulling her back whenever she would go to fast for me. I know that 'yanking' is not great for her neck and I had been looking for a harness I can use instead. This Amazon Basics fits her perfectly. It is lightweight, hugs her body and prevents that yanking. It took her about two or three days to get used to the harness, but now I wouldn't go back to her standard collar. It is easy to fit on her and it's a breeze for her and I now when we are walking. I highly recommend this brand (and I know it is reasonably priced when compared to other harnesses on the market today).

title: Great rawhide chew that my dog just loves!

Aussie Shepherd mix) immediately grabbed one when I opened the package and disappeared to the corner to begin devouring it. Anyway, don't want to be negative about this too much as your dog may take to this bone immediately, unlike mine. I will be returning to rawhide chews for Roxie.

title: Wonderful, healthy dog treats that my dog absolutely loves!
text: My finicky 3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix went absolutely nuts over these. She first walked around for a few minutes with it in her mouth (like she was displaying a small trophy, lol). But then when she finally got around to eating this, she went off to a corner and devoured it. Typically, she snubs her nose at most things, or at least it takes her a while before she tries new things, but this time was different. I love when I can give her something she likes and now that I have found these Cadet treats I will be buying them again. title: This is a great assist to dogs with allergies and a great supplement to Apoquel
text: My 4 year old Aussie-Shepherd mix has had skin allergies (grasses) since I 'rescued' her 3 years ago. Since that time, she has been on Apoquel (3/4 of a pill a day). This has been a very costly treatment for me (running a little over $200 every 3 months). I have now cut her dosage down to 1/2 a pill a day, and may try it down to 1/3 of a pill shortly. Supplementing her with the Pro-Sense allergy tablet has really helped with this reduction in medication (and is saving me money). I have noticed no additional itching/licking/scratching since cutting her Apoquel dosage and I attribute it to the Pro-Sense. I am not sure if I will ever fully be able to eliminate the Apoquel, but I will say that it is far easier for me to be stretching the cost upwards of 5 months instead of 3 months is a huge benefit to me.
