This is a great treat dispenser for any one who loves their dogs!

title: Great fun for all mid to large size dogs!
text: I have a load of DII pet toy products and I love them for my 3 year old Roxie. She is an Aussie Shepherd mix about 42 lbs and the size of this squeaky toy is just perfect for her. Quality made, flawless construction and the mix of materials and patterns (including a furry tail) is great for Roxie when she is carrying it around in her mouth. The squeaky mechanism is housed right in the middle of the toy (where the waist would be which makes it great while she is carrying it (she always looks so surprised when it squeaks, lol). Not to worry about your dog being able to destroy it, this dog toy is well constructed and really tough (as are all DII toys).

title: Tasty cat food that your feline may love!
text: My finicky feline actually likes these. Previously fed Blue Buffalo, she normally does not like a lot of new things when I introduce them. That's why I was amazed when I tried her on these and she took to them immediately. I am deducting one star simply because I know these grocery brands (including Fancy Feast) are not the healthiest for my Lucy. I really wish these varieties would go a little further and make products with all natural ingredients and make meat/fish the first ingredient in their products. In a pinch, they are good to have around and I do plan on continuing to feed her these. Only maybe once a week and maintain the rest of her diet with the better all-natural brands.

title: Roxie loves these and they are good for her!
text: These are great all natural dog treats and my Roxie (3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix) just loves them. All natural, grain free, these are great chew snacks that she will tackle and chew on for a long while. I do like Buffalo Range products and have bought them in the past because of their quality ingredients. If you have a dog who loves to chew, loves to be rewarded and is good for them, these treats are just the thing to satisfy. Kudos for another great product!!!

title: The best cat treats out there and my cat just loves them!
text: My typically finicky older (14 years old), absolutely loves Greenies treats. And, given the fact that I would never be able to brush her teeth (lest I wanted to lose a pint of blood, lol), I love that Greenies help keep tartar at bay and help clean her teeth. This Tuna variety is one of her favorites and I try to always keep a supply in the house at all times for her. Good for her and she loves them, the perfect combination!!!

title: Roxie loves Greenies and these Original large varieties are her favorites!
text: My dog, who rarely eats anything but people food, loves Greenies and these large dog treats are among her favorites. She is technically a mid-size dog (3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix weighing about 40 lbs) and probably would be better off with the smaller versions of these. But she loves to chew and giving her the large size gives her an hour of happy munching. I know by buying Greenies I am buying something good for my dog and that it is something she absolutely loves!

title: My dog didn't like this, but then again she is finicky. May work for others.
text: Sorry, but my 42 lb. Aussie Shepherd mix 3 year old pup just didn't like these. She is a finicky eater (which is why I am giving it 3 stars instead of only 1). But she totally snubbed her nose at these and wouldn't eat them. I typically feed her Blue Buffalo and Wellness brands which she will readily eat up. Not sure if it's the consistency or the fact that it's not the quality of the higher priced natural brands, but I ended up throwing out three of these packages. After reading some of these other reviews, I am thinking maybe I will wait a week or so and try mixing it with her dry food and see if that may make the difference. If it works, I will revise this review.if there is a difference in her reaction next week.

title: Great bed, well constructed and attractive!
text: This is a beautiful, well made, pet bed. I was really hoping I could use this for my 43 lb Aussi Shepherd/Border collie mix, but she is just a little too big for it (keep that in mind when ordering for your dog). I have seen my cat checking it out, hoping she may be the one who ultimately gets to use this. Anyway, coloring is attractive, stitching is great, cushion is soft. Comes packaged in a thin long box which keeps the bed rolled until you open it. Rolls out perfect. Just wish this had been the right size, but it is a great pet bed! Highly recommend!

title: Great new variety of pill pockets!
text:
My 40 lb. Aussie-Shepherd mix loves these pill pockets. Having skin allergies since I have had her (doctor says probably grass), she has been on Apoquel for 2 years now. So, every morning she gets three quarters of a pill using half of one of these pill pockets. Long removed from the days when I used to try to shove the pill down the back of her throat, Roxie now looks for her pill every morning (she thinks of it as a treat
). Typically I have used the plain chicken flavor, but she really loves this new hickory smoked variety. Nothing but kudos for Greenies to make pill giving a joy for the owner and a treat for the dog!!!!

title: Great brand, all natural ingredient dog food!
text: My dog is typically a picky eater (Aussie Shepherd mix) and her reaction to this Nutro Hearty Stews was not unusual for her. She honestly didn't like it and licked a bit, but then snubbed her nose at it. I hate to give a poor review for a product when I am sure the way she reacted is not typical for other dogs. Nutro typically makes great products and this seems to fit the bill to align with their other products and it contains ingredients especially for the senior dog with typical joint, bone, skin/coat issues in your life. All natural ingredients (including real chicken) is in the ingredients and any other dog (excluding my Roxie) would typically love this variety. It is also very reasonably priced.

title: Great liner for use in your kitchen, colorful, practical and protects
text: This is my second DII pet 'placemat' and I have nothing but great things to say. Fits under my dog's double bowl perfectly, helps minimize any water that laps onto the floor. This color is really cute and makes me feel patriotic using it, lol. No complaints, does the job, protects your floor from spills and food and looks great.

title: 16 year old Petey does a happy dance with this spray millet!!!
text: I have a 16 year old cockateil who just loves this millet. Just taking it out an going to put it in his cage he anxiously paces and chirps until he is able to get at it. Considering his age, I haven't seen him this excited in years for a treat. If I had any complaint at all it's the way Kaytee packages this product. It would be nice if it were in packages inside the box or more portioned as it makes it difficult to have to keep this a fresh product as is. I needed to buy large zip lock bags to store these so that they will last a while (20 lbs of millet is a lot for just one bird). Not sure if this packaging is more for breeders or pet shops, but as a single bird owner, need to keep this fresher in a better method. Outside of that, the product is great and Petey loves his seed treats!!

title: Roxie loves Greenies and I do, too!
text: My typically finicky canine absolutely loves Greenies. I also love that they help keep her breath fresh and reduce the tartar buildup on her teeth. It is a real treat for me when I can give her something that she loves and that I know is good for her. She loves all the varieties of Greenies but I think she likes this regular variety the best of all. If you haven't tried Greenies, this is the one you should start with. It's a medium size variety (just perfect for her size which is 42 lbs). Highly recommend!

title: Roxie and I both love this Grain-free variety!
text: My Roxie loves regualr Greenies. I had never tried the Grain-free variety until now, so I was a little skeptical in seeing if she would like it. Being that she has a lot of allergies, I knew that a grain free variety would be be an excellent choice for her health. To my surprise, my typically finicky pup readily accepted this new variety (just as she does with the standard type).Upon opening the box, she took the first one out of my hand, gobbled up and was begging for more.Now that I know she really likes these, I am going to switch her over to grain free exclusively. By the way, these greenies (like all varieties) are great for keeping my little girl's breath and teeth clean as well. These are a must have for any dog lover's household.

title: Great treats even for the pickiest cat!
text: My typically finicky feline loves Temptations, so when I saw this new Shrimp flavor I jumped at the opportunity for her to try it. As anticipated, the minute I opened the bag she was standing at my side to try it. She gobbled up the 5 I gave her, so I know she loved them. As a treat, Temptations are great and are one of the few treats she will eat. If you have a finicky cat like mine, you need to give these a try. I am not sure if it is the crunch or the taste or both, but something about them has her constantly asking for more (although I need to keep a handle on her weight, lol). I highly recommend them to everyone with a cat they love!

title: Great idea! Quick set up, easy disposal!
text: This is absolutely a fantastic idea. I like to go RV'ing and one of these boxes (with additional litter refills) can last me for up to two weeks (as long as I clean it daily). This is easy to set up (just follow the video) and you are good to go. My cat did not like the litter it came with so I brought along my usual Tidy Cat and it was wonderful being able to use it and then just dispose of it when we were on our way home. It is a little bit of an extravagance at $22 a pop, but it is a nifty great idea to be able to set up and dispose and keep everything neat and clean along the way. I definitely would be sure your cat will use the litter before you start to travel. I also would recommend, to try using a cat liner in the box to extend the life even longer.

title: Great life vest for the dog in your life. A must have for any boat owner!
text: This is a great device. I have a 3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix (about 40 lbs) who honestly does not care for the water. I am assuming (as I can't technically get in her mind, lol) that her fear has something to do with the unfamiliarity of the water and of her lack of swimming in her day to day life. I use this vest every time we go out in the boat. With it on, I know that she is protected in the event we had to vacate the boat (we technically use the boat in the intercoastal waterway here in south florida. I have carried her into the water with me when I wade in waist deep water to let her try it out and I honestly think she enjoys the added protection and it gives her some self confidence in the water. I highly recommend this vest for your loved animals for when you take them out on the ocean/lake/sea (like you would with your own children).

title: Great for total clean up, not so great for every day maintenance
text: To be honest, I only totally clean my cat's litter box maybe twice a year. In using this Slide product by Arm and Hammer, I did like the way the litter did easily slide out (I did it after the first pour so I could do this review accurately. However, the next few times when I was just scooping the littler, I didn't like the way this cat litter clumps. In fact, it clumps poorly and I found that it was difficult to clean the cat litter on a maintenance basis (litter crumbles and does not clump adequately). As far as odor control goes, again for the litter that cleaned it was great. But for the litter that crumbled I found an odor still remained and was only good when the entire litter was removed. I am rating this as 4 stars because it does what it says for total cat letter box clean up. However, I don't think I will be purchase this in the future since I only do a total cleaning a few times a year.

title: Great daily multi-vitamin for your dog, and they like them, too!
text: I have nothing but great things to say about this Pro-Sense multi-vitamin. My 40 lb. 3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix is an extremely picky eater. There are days when she seems to only want to eat treats and cheese, lol. I , at first, was hesistant ordering these as I thought for sure she wouldn't eat them. I was surprised to see that she ate it like it was a treat and has been taking them daily now for 3 weeks. I feel confident knowing that her terrible eating habits and diet is being supplemented with the vitamins and nutrients that she needs to stay young and healthy. Kudos Pro-sense for not only giving us a product that is good for our dogs but also that even the pickiest pets will eat!

title: Great nutritious food for your dog, if they like this variety
text: Rating this 4 stars simply because it is Blue Wilderness, who I (and my dog) typically love. All natural, great nutrition and grain free, Blue Wilderness is a quality dog food. However, I have to state that for whatever reason, my Australian Shepherd mix Roxie will not eat this variety. I have tried 4 tubs of this, intermixed several days apart with other varieties, and she just snubbed her nose at it. I feel that it is not worth giving this a negative review simply because there are probably other dogs who will love it and the quality of the food definitely deserves at least a 4 star review.

title: Great dish, quality constructive, perfect for the 'pushy' eater in your house!
text: This is truly a beautiful pet bowl. Well made, heavy, with a rubber piece around the bottom (to help prevent your dog from pushing it around), I was really impressed with this dish. My Australian shepherd (about 40 lbs) is typically a sloppy eater and will push bowls as she licks the food all around the kitchen. With this DII bowl, she is unable to budge it and I couldn't be happier. I am currently using this for water but I am in the process of ordering another for her food as I think these are so attractive and a true quality item.

title: Lucy actually loved these and they are critical to her aging teeth health
text: I was a little hesitant on getting this Meow Mix for my feline (Lucy) as she tends to not like Meow Mix overall and is an extremely finicky eater. I was pleasantly surprised to see that the moment I opened the package and took a few out, she readily ate them. Given that she is an older cat (13 years old), I worry about her teeth (and she will not allow me to even attempt to brush them). I love that I can reward her with treats while at the same time helping to remove tarter. I am ordering more of these to give her in lieu of the ones we normally give her (she likes Temptations best) to help improve her dental health.

title: Wonderful cat food that my finicky feline absolutely loves!
text: I have to start by saying that I have probably one of the most pickier eaters when it comes to my Lucy. She typically will only eat one or two canned foods and even then only certain varieties. Hence, I was skeptical when I was offered this Wellness Grain Free to try. I was absolutely amazed that she immediately began to eat it at the moment I set it in front of her. I have always preferred Wellness products and feed them almost exclusively to my dog. However, with Lucy everything has been hit or miss. Wellness products are all natural and made of only the finest ingredients. Sure, they are more expensive than typical supermarket cat food, but in this case you truly get what you pay for. I will be ordering the chicken variety next to see if I might be able to switch her to an exclusive Wellness diet.

title: Fabulous dog food that my little Wally simply loves!
text: This is an absolutely perfect food for my Lhapso. Perfect bite size proportions, the first time I put this down for dinner for him he gobbled it up, That absolutly says alot considering how picky he can be when it comes to food choices. I jumped on this because of the salmon ingredient (I have a cat in the house also and Wally tends to eat all of her food if I don't keep them separated). Felt like the fish ingredient might make him think he was eating Lucy's food, lol. Anyway, all natural ingredients, I always depend on Nulo for providing good, healthy nutrion for my dogs (I also have an Australian Shepherd mix), and it really helps when my dogs love the food as well. Kudos Nulo for another great food!

title: Great quality dog food!
text: Absolutely great dog food. I was immediately impressed with the list of ingredients and seeing that cod was the first item on the list. Also has supplemental vitamin properties (B-12 and C). And, from my dog's point of view, she loved the food. Given that she is a super picky eater, I was thrilled to see her immediately smell and continue to chow down. My dog is not overweight by much, but she does have a tendency to be a little lazy and sleeps quite a bit, so I have always been concerned about her putting weight on in her later years (she is just about 3 years old now). So, this Trim variety is perfect for her. I am thrilled (as is she) with this Nulo brand and variety!

title: Great size! Great chew! My dog loves them!
text: My typically finicky Aussie Shepherd mix (37 lbs), absolutley loved these. It says they are 'small' dental rolls, but they aren't that small. Probably about the length of your middle finger. Roxie loves to chew and is sometimes overwhelmed by larger size biscuits. These Better Belly rolls were a perfect size for her (not sure if they might be too big for a Maltese or in that size range). She readily begged for one when I opened the package and readily ran over to her bedding to begin the chew. I love that these are digestible and not going to cause any health issues with them (as some rawhide chews are known to do. I highly recommend these for even the most finicky dogs.

title: Great chew sticks for your dog. My Roxie loves them!
text: My mid-size (35 lb) Aussie Shepherd mix loves these 6 inch bully sticks. They give her over an hour of heavy duty chewing and she begs for them. I like this size stick for her as she easily can position them in her front paws and enjoy them to her heart's content. I can highly recommend these for even the fussiest of dogs to entertainment them and keep them out of trouble from chewing things you don't want them to.

title: Very disappointed. Great dog food, but my Roxie wouldn't eat it.
text: For the positives of this food: all natural ingredients, grain free, small bite size pieces and loaded with nutrition. For the negative, my picky Aussie Shepherd won't eat it. Unfortunate, too, as I had hear a lot of good things about this Under the Sun brand and I was anxious to try it on her. I am not sure what she didn't like about it. I will say I typically feed her Blue Buffalo, so maybe it is just the change in food for her. Anyway, rating it as 4 stars because I am sure this would work for other dogs. Might want to try a smaller size before you invest in the 25 lb bag in case your dog snubs their nose on it too.

title: Great little device for watching your pets when you aren't home
text: This is a great little device, reasonably priced, to use to monitor your home and pets when you aren't at home. I loved the fact that I can do two way communications with my dog, talking with her and watching her react to my voice when I am not in the room was priceless. Rating it as only 4 stars because of the iPhone software capability and limitations which has been mentioned in several other reviews on here. However, as I said, for under $100 this is a great little gadget and I love using it while I am at work. This would make a really cute unique gift for the holidays for the person who has everything in their life.

title: Great sizable pads, good for any size dog. A little pricey.
text: Great, super large pads for your dog. I love this size as I typically need to use two small ones (just so my pup has room). However, with these I only need one and she can use it more than once. Super absorbent. I am rating it as only 4 stars because of the price. You can get large pads like these a lot cheaper. But, I think these are great if you are willing to pay the higher price.

title: Great pill pockets, my dog loved them!
text: My dog Roxie has some kind of allergy to grass and such and has been on daily Apoquel to help control the itching and licking. I typically use other pill pockets (sold on Amazon) to help her in taking her half pill every morning. I like the fact that these are a little larger, so for me they will last longer. I break the VetIQ Pill treat in half and mold it around the pill. Surprisingly, Roxie took to these immediately (despite the fact that she can be a bit picky when it comes to trying new things). I think these are great and actually work out to be cheaper than the ones I use today, so I will be switching over to VetIQ!

title: Great cat food, Lucy loves it!
text: I am rating this cat food as a 4 instead of 5 star simply because of the price per serving. At almost $1.50 a pop, it is more than twice as expensive as the regular moist food I feed my Lucy. I will say, though, that I love the all natural ingredients (ok, some ingredients I had not heard of before, but Nature's Recipe usually sells itself as an upscale product, so I am relying on their reputation for the ones I don't recognize). I also love that this is a grain free food, which helps minimizes allergy sensitivity which my feline typically has. Most of all, this is by far one of her favorite foods to date. And, considering how finicky she tends to be, I am thrilled at how she likes it. I will be buying more, but will try to shop for a lower price.

title: My older cat was not impressed. You can make this yourself.
text: I would really have liked to rate this as 2 stars, but in fairness to the manufacturer and other reviewers here, I am only deducting 2 stars. I have an 8 year old female (who is still very active, curious and likes to play). She has not looked at this once since I unwrapped it and put it down. It is relatively small (a cat can just about stand on it) and made of cardboard. Yes, looks like something I could honestly make myself with a box and some astroturf and scissors to cut holes out of a small box. I think if you have kittens, they may love it. But, with an older cat, she wasn't impressed.

title: Great and nutritious, just a tad expensive for the amount you get.
text: Amazingly, my finicky female dog ate up the entire portion in one sitting. I was surprised as she has all but given up on regular dry food and canned dog food (no matter the brand or how I try to tempt her). She had gotten to the point she wanted to eat what I eat and would devour snacks. I was thrilled to see she really liked this ZiwiPeak and the ingredients are all natural and highest quality. If I had any complaint at all it would be the price. At two scoops a serving, I will be lucky to get about week of meals, and at $18 a bag, I think I will only be buying this occasionally. Rating it 5 stars though because it is a great alternative and picky dogs love it.

title: Another great Hill's product for the dog you love!
text: I ordered this for my dog Roxy. She loved this roasted beef flavor (gobbling it up as soon as the first can was opened) and I know I can always depend on the Hill's brand for quality and value for my dog. High in nutrition and made in the United States, Hill's products are the ones I usually reach for first when at Petco. No complaints, just a great solid food that your dog will love and thank you for in loads of puppy kisses!

title: Wonderful life jacket for the dog you love and who loves the water!
text: This is an adorable as well as practical and useful and a must have item for anyone who has a dog who loves being in the water. This size medium fits my 37 lb Aussie Shepherd mix pup perfectly. I love the straps on the top which mak it easy to get her out of the water and back on to the boat in a flash. Like I said, too, the pattern and color are adorable and the orange makes her so easy to spot. No complaints, just kudos!

title: Excellent dog food! I love it and my dog loves it too!
text: My finicky Aussie Shepherd really likes this Nutro Chicken and Lentils product. And I love the fact that she is getting a wholesome, quality food which is made here in the US. Given my Roxie has some grass and other allergies, the plus in this food is it's grain free ingredients. I find she is scratching much less than normal. I have been using Nutro products for years now for her and this product lives up to the typically high standards that this company. You can rely on Nurtro to provide your pet the excellent care and nutrition they need. It also helps that my dog will readily eat and enjoy this food as well!

title: Great nutritous snack for the dog in your life!
text: I love Blue Buffalo products for my Roxie. Not only are they a quality product (made of all natural ingredients), but they are good for her and she loves them. These Bayou biscuits are one of her favorites. Perfect size for a mid-size dog (she is a 38 lb Aussie Shepherd mix), she gobbles these up as a reward every time I offer them to her. I depend on Blue Buffalo to give her nutritious treats and the Bayou Blend biscuits are no exception. Kudos to Wilderness Blue Buffalo for another product both I and my dog love!!!

title: Nice quick refresher for the beach going pooch
text: I need to start by stating I live in sunny Florida, a few miles from the beach. I take my dog regularly to the beach to run and play in the water and the sand. Typically, when she is done, I use the little shower device on the outskirts of the beach area to rinse her off. But I know she is not really clean and hours later I can still smell the beachy dog and end up giving her a bath. With these grooming wipes in hand, I run it over her after she has been rinsed and towel dried and I noticed an immediate improvement. The scent is lovely and it seems to stay with her. Although I will probably regularly have to wash her anyway, these wipes, in a pinch do the job to keep her fresh smelling. I keep them in my glove compartment. As someone else mentioned here, it would be nicer if they were a little larger. My dog is a 38 lb. midsized dog and I need to use at least 2-3 of these per use.

title: Another great Hill's product that both I, and my cat, love!
text: Great cat food that my finicky feline will finally eat. I love Hill's Science Diet products. Always rich on flavor and quality and my cat loves it. Science Diet does cost a tad more than anything I would normally buy in the supermarket. However, you get what you pay for and I know my cat is worth it and her health is my upmost priority.

title: Best training pads on the market!
text: These pet training pads are terrific. Not only are they economical (thanks Amazon Basics!) but they are large enough that I only need one for my 37 lg Aussie Shepherd pup. They are strong and absorbent. I have used several types of these training pads in the past, but these are by far my favorite! I love Amazon Basics for delivering quality at far less than other leading brands. Kudos!

title: Not for my Lucy, but maybe for another cat
text: Not sure if I should rate this three stars at all, but in fairness to Pet Zone, I am thinking that maybe it was just my pet. When I inserted the battery and turned this on, my cat was immediately interested. But that was about it. I think it's because it moves too fast and not sporadically enough (like one other reviewer stated, it's almost like being hypnotized in its spinning around and around and around). She sat and watched it for about 20 minutes, but then got bored and walked away. My dog was actually more interested in it than the cat, but both just watched. No one did anything to try to pounce or 'catch' the butterfly. I mean, it is cute and I was fascinated with it as well. However as a cat toy? Nah, didn't interest my feline.

title: Excellent cat litter! Great value size!
text: I use Arm and Hammer cat litter almost exclusively. Low dust, great odor control, great clumping factor and I actually find myself using less than other littler brands. This 28 lb size is also perfect for my needs and lasts me a few weeks in my one cat household (with daily cleaning). I have no complaints, with the possible exception of the fragrance, but it is not noticeable in the room (only when I poured it) and I am sure it is just a matter of preference. My cat uses this and seems ok with the product as well.

title: One of the best, healthiest dog foods on the market - but my dog didn't like it
text: I really wanted to rate this 5 stars. I mean, I love Wellness products and the fact that they have all natural ingredients and I know it's one of the healthiest products for my dog (she loves their dry foods). But, honestly, she snubbed her nose at this. I actually have opened 2 cans in the last 2 days and she comes over, smells it, and walks away. I am going to try this again over the weekend. If she decides she likes it, I will go back in and change/update this review. I would suggest buying a single can at Petco or PetSmart before ordering a case of this to be sure your dog likes it.

title: My dog flipped over the taste and was begging for more, lol!
text: I have been using this for almost two weeks now. Hard to decide if the shedding has really begun to abate, but so far I do notice a difference on the areas that used to gather her fur (my off white comforter looks somewhat better). So, I am only rating it as 4 stars, but I will use this until the product runs out and update my rating to 5 if I really see less hair). I will say that my dog loves this product, acts like I am giving her a treat. She does have a tendency to know when I am giving her other vitamins and will snub her nose. Not with the Shed no More product. Great natural ingredients which, even if the shedding magic doesn't magically disappear, allows me to want to continue to buy and give this to her.

title: Nice fun toy for smaller dogs
text: Ok dog toy. My 2 year old Aussie Shepherd had to be coaxed to know what to do with it. Once she did, she nosed it around a few times for the treats to fall out. Once the treats were out she wasn't interested any more. I was not a fan either that I am unable to open this to clean the inside. Most of the treats I have are soft for her and I don't like that I can't clean it if some stay in there for more than a few hours. As others mentioned, too, they didn't design this right with the holes being directly opposite each other, makes it awkward for loading. Other than that, it's fun. Probably meant more for a smaller dog who will nose it around and get a kick out of the rolling. Bigger dogs probably won't appeal to it.

title: Attractive cat tree for younger felines
text: Attractive, quality made cat tree. Very sizeable. The rug covering is very soft. Took me hours over several days to try to put this together (one of the few times I wished my ex-husband was around, lol). The end result was an attractive piece of cat furniture. Unfortunately, my 8 year old cat wasn't interested in it. Maybe it's the size of it? She did sit on the lowest base and eventually made it to the first level, but would not go I in the little cubby holes. I think this is definitely geared toward the younger/kitten set. Not sure how long I will keep this up in my room (as I said, it's large), if she is not using it.

title: Great treats! My dog Roxie loves them!!!
text: Of course, my dog is not difficult to please (she loves to eat). However, I will say that sometimes she can be finicky when it coms to soft treats. She is a 35 lb Aussie Shepherd mix and I thinking these might be too small for her. However, these are about 2-3 inches in length and they were big enough to keep her busy for a few minutes before she swallowed and started to beg for more. I read the ingredient label and Hill's Diet lives up to its healthy reputation.  This is a great tasty, and healthy, treat for dogs of all sizes (if you have a miniature dog you can always break these easily in two pieces).

title: My dog thanks you!
text: My dog absolutely loves the Ideal Balance Hill's brand. She gobbles it up whenever I feed her and I knw it is healthy for her as well. She does tend to get skin allergies easily (not sure if it's gluten causing it or outside factors), but I honestly can see her coat and skin looking healthier when she is on this as an exclusive diet. Might be a little pricey on Ammy, but you get the benefit of deliver to the door (no more carting it home) and free two day delivery with Prime, so I order it monthly.

title: Great litter fo the feline in your life!

I couldn't be happier to know that she likes and will actually eat something that is good for her. My only complaint is that there is no resealable packaging on this (to keep the product fresh. I ended up emptying the bag and putting it in a Tupperware container. I hate when manufacturers do that. I mean, it will take a month for her to go through this bag and, if I didn't repackage, it would be stale.

title: Great natural dry food for the feline in your household!

I honestly wasn't sure how she would react to oatmeal as it is not something she has ever had before, but I was pleasantly surprised to see her gobble it down. This was my first experience with the Beyond Natural brand and I love that I am feeding her something which is natural and good for her (and that she likes as well). Took off one star as the bag spilled some during transit (UPS) and I think it could have been packaged better to make the trip here more successful. Other than that, the product is great and I would recommend it to even the most finicky of cats!

title: Not sturdy and cat was not comfortable
text:
This window seat was very easy to put together, it just did not stay together very well. That was a deal breaker and it is being returned. It consists of :

* Rectangular frame for the seat part.. BEWARE : make sure you install the folding hinge in the middle, so that the frame folds upwards, not down... otherwise it will collapse when your cat jumps onto it. Also, the frame has a thin metal bar that runs across the middle of the bed. This sticks up considerably in the middle of the bed and makes an uncomfortable bump. My senior cat hated it, and would not stay in a stretched out position. He left the seat after 10 minutes and never got back in... he practically lived in his old one.

* 2 metal legs to support the frame on the bottom: we had trouble with these staying in the slots at the edges of the frame.... once it was put onto the window, the leg on one side kept drifting out. There is nothing to lock or hold the legs into place on the frame.

* Cushiony polyester seat cushion: BEWARE: this cushion has a strip of velcro at the edges of the 4 sides, so that you can install it by wrapping it around the 4 metal bars of the frame. There is only 1 piece of velcro... so this has to stick to the fabric alone, which is not a very secure hold on neoprene-like polyester. This is the only way to secure the fabric seat part onto the frame, unless you do what another reviewer did, and sew it together once it is on the frame.

* 4 suction cups: these worked pretty well for the few hours that we tested it out. I am not sure if they would stay on long term

I love that I can use the Velcro pouch on the butt area to keep her leg openings up. The onesie still completely covers Snuggles surgical site with the legs in Velcro. I decided to leave the legs up indefinitely as a way to allow Snuggles to use the restroom at her leisure. Although Snuggles hasn't had this onesie very long, I think it’s perfect at this point. title: Great Stairs with wide steps for a smaller dog!
text: LOVE these stairs! I spent hours researching the different items for my dog. Be REALLY careful- a lot of the stairs sold have a narrow depth and my dog (only 12 pounds) would find them too narrow to go down. These are sturdy and are wide enough that she has no issues going down the stairs. My vet said since her eye sight is not great (she is a very active 14 year old dog) her depth perception isnt as good anymore so she needs something to get up and down the bed. He said he sees a lot of dogs with broken legs, and broken teeth because they misjudge the jump off the bed/sofa and get injured. I bought these stairs and a nightlight. They are perfect! She uses them all the time and I don’t have to worry about her falling. I bought the medium size just to be safe and I’m glad I did. I think if you have a really big dog (Lab, German Shepherd, etc) you may want to consider wooden stairs or a ramp. These foam stairs won’t hold the weight of a large dog like a lab. Hope this info helps!

text: My little Yorkis is a retired breeder that was in a kennel the first 7 years of her life. She had to learn to be with people and become a pet. It's been 18 months and she's still getting there. She's fearful of anything new so of course she would not step foot in this bed for a month. I had her groomed and she came home pretty naked and unhappy. Her old bedding was in the wash and all I had was the new bed in its spot. She checked the bedroom because she also has a bed in there.  That bed was gone too. She proceeds to potty in front of my chair to show her disapproval but withing 30 minutes I look over and she's climbed into her new bed. A few hours later I look over and she's belly up, paws in the air and snoring.  She absolutely loves this bed. It is snuggly, soft and like a big fluffy marshmallow. You can't always tell the quality of something when ordering. This is a maximum quality bed. I've seen others that aren't full. They look deflated. This one doesn't. We are both so happy with this bed. It's actually stolen her from me. It's hard to get her in my lap now. I guess I'm not soft enough. LOL The next one will be for the bedroom. I would have her in bed with me, but again. Everything scares her so a bed beside me will have to do.

title: The beef stick dance
text: I've had my dog Baby for just over a year. She's a retired breeding dog. She's a chunky Yorkie weighing about 10 pounds.  Was born and raised in a breeding kennel. She had to learn how to be a pet.  She was terrified of people and stayed in the corner of my room for over a month. I gained her trust with food. She had never had anything except dried kibble. Over year later she's be totally different dog.  Her favorite foods were cheese and chicken until we discovered these beef sticks.  She is totally in love with them. We are on our second bag. She now does what I call the beef stick dance. She jumps in my lap and acts all loving until I ask what she want's. She jumps down and does the beef stick dance, hoping around all excited and cute.  I ask if she wants a beef stick and she heads for the kitchen dancing and looking back to make sure I'm coming. Unfortunately I've spoiled. I'd like to say she's learned to do something significant by teaching her and using the beef sticks as a reward.  Nope. Not me and my dog. All she has to do is ask and do her cute little beef stick dance that melts my heart and she gets her treat.  I can say that these treats have greatly increased her trust and she's opened up more by playing and being her true self. A sweet little puppy who's only worry is guarding the house and making sure the cats don't take over the front porch. Life is good.

He’s a pitbull mix and is roughly 50lb. This is just a quicker method than walking him around the whole yard on leash like I originally had done.

This collar was originally bought for her but I used it on the above dog to make training faster for him.
I adopted a larger pitbull mix about 90lb and she has zero recall so I decided to try this to try and help her listen when I call her and all that good stuff, the beep she didn’t care about at all so I moved up the scale of the vibrate and she didn’t react to that at all so I tried the shock on myself first on all the levels to see how strong they were before I used on her and as we worked up all the levels she still didn’t react or anything so I don’t recommend this for any dog over 70lb maybe even just 60lb. I wish this worked for her so she’d be able to life her off leash free life like her “brother” is able to.

title: DOG DID NOT LIKE IT
text: I have known about Hill's Science Diet for a number of years and I believe it to be quality food.  Unfortunately my dog just would not eat it.  He did not like it.  The dog did not eat for two days in a row, when he was severed this food.  I noticed too that even though this is a canned food, it seemed to be rather dry in the can.  I don't know if it is normally that way or not.  Too bad, as this is supposed to be a quality dog food and better for dogs than some cheaper brands.

title: DOG DID NOT CARE FOR IT, BUT DID EAT THEM
text: My dog did not seem to eager to eat these treats.  Perhaps he just wasn't that familiar with salmon flavor, as he doesn't usually ever get any fish.  Most treats he likes right away and practically inhales them; this one just didn't do it for him, although he did eat them all over the course of a few days.  Seems like a good product with good ingredients.  I suggest trying it with your dog, as he or she may love these.

title: Dog loved this; gone in just a couple days
text: With quality ingredients and a flavor that the dog loved, these treats were a real winner.  The dog demolished these in just 2 or 3 days.

title: The dog liked it quite well
text: These seemed like kind of large pieces to give the dog all at once, but they broke apart easily, which I consider a really plus.  Some jerky is so hard you can't easily divide it up; these were soft enough so that probably even old dogs that may have poor teeth could probably chew them up easily.  The limited, quality ingredients is a big plus.  The most important thing is that the dog liked these (my dog doesn't always care that much for some dog treats).

title: THE DOG LIKES IT AND THAT'S WHAT'S IMPORTANT
text: While these are intended for small dogs, I feed them to my larger dog, several at a time or I use them as toppers for some of his other food.  He is getting to be an extremely picky eater and often has to be encouraged to eat or even hand fed.  He seems to enjoy these Beneful packets quite well and tends to eat better when I give him these or use them as toppings.  They can get a little expensive if you use them as the primary meal for a larger dog, if you have to give him several, but no more so than other premium dog foods.  I have tried him on a lot of different wet dog foods and some of them he just does not care for.  At least he seems to like these and I think most dogs will.

title: Great as a topper for picky dogs
text: These are intended for small dogs as a complete meal, but I found they work great to get my large dog to eat his food when he gets picky.  He likes the taste of all the Bella flavors and often by putting it on top of his regular food, he will eat the whole bowl, instead of ignoring it as he often does when it is not jazzed up.  Sometimes he will just eat the Bella and not the remainder of his food.  I wish Bella made large cans too.

title: Does not appear to contain much meat
text: I keep trying different dry dog food in the hopes that my dog will find one that he really likes.  Dry is better for his teeth that wet food or human food.  Unfortunately this is just one more that he didn't eat.  I have tried several of the Amazon Solimo products and find them to generally be of comparable quality to name brands and I certainly would try any of the products over a name brand when the price is better.  The price for this dog food seems reasonable, but I think for a few dollars more you could get a much higher quality dog food.  What I didn't realize when I ordered this is that CORN is the number one ingredient in this food and not chicken.  It is only chicken flavored, which could mean just about anything.  As with any dog food, if you are okay with the ingredients and the price, try it and see if you dog likes it.  Just like people, dogs have their own individual tastes.  I think the Solimo brand (which I think is rather new) shows a lot of promise, but of course some of their products will be better than others.  This food claims to meet certain feeding standards, so it is worth trying to see if your dog relishes it or shuns it.

title: Dog doesn't care much for it
text: I have tried my dog with different brands of Paté a couple of times and he just doesn't really care for it much, so probably will not try it again.  My dog is too large for one of these to fill him up, but sometimes I get small tubs like this as a topping for his regular food.  Sometimes it helps to encourage him to eat (he is very picky) and sometimes it doesn't; depends on the brand and consistency of the food.  I have used Nutro products before with other dogs and I believe them to be of good quality.  As with any dog food, you have to try it first and see if the dog likes it.

title: Dog would not eat it
text: My dog didn't like this.  He wouldn't even touch it.  You do need to be aware that it has a consistency like clay or paste; maybe putty or spackling would be a better description.  I hate to give a poor review just because my dog didn't like it.  He is getting very picky about his food.  Since this appears to be good quality food, try it and see if your dog likes it or not.  I noticed at least one reviewer who said his dog absolutely loved it.  Just like people, dogs seem to have their preferences and sometimes they go crazy for something new; other times I guess it just doesn't smell right to them.

title: Dog didn't seem to want it
text: My dog has been very picky lately about what he eats, so try this before you decide whether or not to get it on a regular basis.  My dog was not the least bit interested in this and had to end up giving it away.  He wouldn't even taste it.  That's the thing about dog food.  Each dog has his own preferences and what might be something that one wants, another won't.  From the label this seems like good quality food, so you probably won't go wrong buying this.

title: Wonderful design; easy to put on; watch the sizes
text: I am giving this 5 stars, even though I was not able to use it.  It is supposed to be the large size, but it seems pretty small and would not fit my medium sized 50 pound dog.  I would suggest ordering one size larger than you think you might need.  It appears to be really well made and very easy to put on. The reflective nature is a bonus.  It looks like it would hold up quite well.  I have tried several different harnesses and most are complicated enough so that they are not easy to figure out; the dog got out of one that I tried last time, so must not have put it on correctly.  With this harness, you cannot make a mistake.  The only other problem that I had with this is that it has a Velcro strip to help hold it together and my dog freaked out when I opened the Velcro.  He did not like that sound at all!  Check to see if your dog is okay with Velcro before you buy this.  I think I am going to maybe buy the extra large size and see if it works well for me.

title: Good for picky dogs to jazz up their usual food
text: My dog is getting so that he doesn't like his ordinary canned dog food.  Even premium fresh dog food he isn't always enthusiastic about.  These pour overs are just the thing to get him interested and start eating.  Once he got a taste, he finished his whole bowl of food.  I am familiar with Honest Kitchen and their products are good quality with wholesome ingredients.  Have tried a couple of their other items and the dogs seemed to like them, as well as this one.  Give it a try if your dog is not eating as enthusiastically as he once was.

title: Soft fluffy surface; Nice for a bigger dog
text:
I got this for my medium sized dog, but it was really bigger than what he needed, so gave it to my grandson for his dog, which is big dog and it fits him perfectly. He liked it right away, whereas my dog just sniffed it, but wouldn't get on it.
This is a quality pet bed and looks like it will hold up well. It has a nice, soft fluffy surface and a good foam base. Seems much nicer than beds that are stuffed. If I need to replace another pet bed, would probably get this kind again.

title: Dog likes this; limited ingredients, smells good
text: These seemed pretty hard to me, but the dog crunched them right down and obviously liked them.  I would not try to give it to a dog with bad or sensitive teeth who requires softened food.  Dogs like some pretty funky smells, but I still don't like to give my dogs anything that doesn't smell good to me.  These smell good to the human nose and they have limited ingredients.  Also seem to be made in U.S.A., so most likely very safe.  Apparently good quality and tasty to the dog.  What more can you ask for?  I also ordered Purina Honest to Dog Tasty Tenders Dog Treats, which have many of the same characteristics except they are soft and chewy, so good for dogs with sensitive or bad teeth; also they are turkey, chicken, rather than the crispy beef treats.

title: Dog Loves It; Well Made
text: The dog rates this 5 stars, at least so far.  He hasn't stopped carrying it around with him since I gave him one of the toys.  I knocked one star off my review for the fact that from a human standpoint, these are not particularly cute; they are just the tail end of 3 different animals, so they don't have much human appeal.  Also, the squeakers in the toys are not very easy to squeak and my dog generally likes toys that have good squeakers.  The toys have a crunch and he does like that, but I don't think he has bit down hard enough to make them squeak.  My dog loves toys and especially new toys, so over time he may lose interest in it, but at least for now, it is his favorite.  Seems durably made.

title: Dog Loved It; Ate it Up Right Away
text: My dog is getting so picky about what he eats, but he loved this and gobbled it up right away.  This seems to contain better ingredients than typical canned dog food.  It does have an odd consistency; kind of dry and after a day of refrigeration, it seems to dry out more.  In spite of that my dog finished a full roll in two days.

title: Neither my dog nor my sister's cats were interested in it
text: This operates as advertised, but my dog did not have the slightest interest in it.  I tried it with cats and one was afraid of it and the other lost interest in it very fast and wouldn't look at it again.  I suppose how much you like this might depend on your animal and what they enjoy.  In fairness, the toy does seem durable and well made; not something that could easily be chewed up.  It has a tough rubber exterior.  Might be just the thing for your pet; mine didn't find it interesting at all.  Doesn't work will on carpet; better for solid floors (tile, wood, vinyl, etc.)

title: Real Food; Not a chopped gooey mess like most dog foods
text: This looks like real food; not like regular dog food.  There are real pieces of chicken and vegetables.  Very convenient if you don't have the time to break up chicken pieces and cook vegetables for the dog.  The containers are small, so for even a medium-sized dog, this is nothing more than a snack, but it also works as a good "topper" to encourage your spoiled dog to eat his regular food.  These are intended, of course, for a small dog but seem a little meager as a meal, so you might have to use two or feed one twice a day.  It appears to be good quality and my dog lapped it up quickly.

title: Safe Substitute for Rawhide with Mostly Quality Ingredients
text: This was an instant hit with my hound dog and he ate up two of them right away.  The list of ingredients seems mostly wholesome.  I had recently gotten some rawhide chews that are similar in size and appearance, but I am always reluctant to give a dog rawhide, as I had one dog who would try to swallow it before it was chewed enough and he almost choked and I had to reach down his throat and pull it out.  No more rawhide for him after that.  The dog I have now does okay with rawhide, but it isn't particularly good for dogs.  These are a great substitute.  When my dog is bored and bugging me a lot, the rawhide kept him occupied for a while.  These are so much easier to consume that they don't keep him busy for quite as long as the rawhide does; that's really the only downside that I can see.  Otherwise, this is a great product.

title: Dog Liked It; good quality; contains sugar and salt; good for occasional treat
text: I have tried other Dingo products and found them to be of good quality.  When I first gave this to the dog, I thought he wasn't interested in it, as he dropped it, but then 1/2 hour later he picked it up and chewed up the whole thing and consumed it completely.  Obviously he found it tasty and enjoyed it.  The only reason I didn't rate this 5 stars is that these contain sugar and salt, both of which are probably not good for dogs,  Also, this is a rawhide product and I just about stopped buying rawhide after one of my dogs nearly choked on it.  I don't think rawhide is particularly good for them and some dogs will try to swallow it before it is completely chewed.  That's not the fault of the product; you just have to know your dog before you buy this kind of treat.  If you do get these, make sure to supervise your dog while he is eating it and pick it up when he has finished with it if he doesn't eat the whole thing.  Throw out any small pieces.  These are great as an occasional treat, but I wouldn't give them often.

title: Instant Hit with my Dogs; they loved it
text: Sadly I have to say that this dog food topping was part of my little chihuahua's last meal.  She really enjoyed it and licked up every bit of it, along with her regular food.  I have to say it was an instant hit with her.  (Her death had no relationship to this product.)  My bigger hound also liked this a lot.  It is a great product and I think your dogs will love it.

title: Didn't Seem Effective on Old Stains; has a very strong, but not unpleasant odor
text: This product might be best for removing fresh stains, but I tried it on some old urine stains and it didn't seem to lighten them up that much.  It has a pleasant odor, but the odor is quite strong and I noticed that it lingered in the air for quite some time.  Does it remove the pet odors or just cover them up with a stronger odor of its' own?  Not sure about that.  I guess I was expecting a miracle with this product, as I have tried so many different things with varying degrees of effectiveness.  Usually have found that I have to run the carpet cleaning machine to really get the stains out.  This product doesn't seem to be any more or any less effective than other products designed to do the same thing.  I haven't used it long, so if I find better results as time passes, will update this review.  At this point, I am not impressed.

title: QUALITY FOOD, BUT DOG DIDN'T CARE FOR IT
text: These days there are so many choices for premium grain-free dog foods, that it is difficult to decide what to get.  The bottom line usually is what the dog likes (other than price considerations, of course).  Unfortunately my big hound dog didn't seem to like this very much.  My little chihuahua liked it and started eating the first time I put it down, but she doesn't eat much dry food, as she has so few teeth left, so sticks mainly with wet food.  My suggestion is the same as when I review any dog food; buy the smallest bag you can to try it first to see if the dog will eat it well.  I would try this one and some other premium foods to see what your dog or dogs like best.  They may really like this one.  I can only rate 3 stars because my dog just didn't go much for it.

title: Quality built; sisal rope wrapping immediate hit with the cats.
text: Easy to assemble, solid, well made. Tool included for assembly.  The instructions were folded backwards, which might lead you to think they are out of order, but they aren't.  The top platform is a little small for a large cat, but is perfect for smaller cats.  For scratching, the cats really like the sisal rope that is wrapped around the legs and started using it immediately.  Took them a little longer to decide to climb up and the large cat could not fit well in the top platform, so stood on it briefly and then got down.  The smaller cat can sit comfortably on the top platform.

title: GREAT SIZE FOR SMALL DOGS
text: These Cesar meals are just the right size for my little chihuahua.  She got tired of the canned dog food that I have been feeding for years.  These look like real food too; not dog food.  My chihuahua doesn't have many teeth left and this is a wet food that is soft enough for her to easy eat.  The important thing is that she likes the taste.  My big hound likes them too, but he gobbles one down pretty quickly.  They are a little pricey if bought individually at the grocery, but the multi-packs come out better on pricing, not taking into account the shipping cost.  The one I got was a 36 count package, but they are apparently available in different multi-packs (such as 12 or 24).  Several reviews I have seen on various websites don't rate this food very highly; too many meat bi-products in it, but my dogs don't have any digestive issues with it.  Probably no worse than most other canned foods and better than some.  They are very convenient and you don't have leftovers as you can with a big can of food.

title: Very Durable Toy; Dog Likes It a Lot
text: This is the second Outward Hound dog toy that I have gotten.  The first one is my dog's favorite toy.  He likes this one a lot too, but hasn't figured out how to squeak it yet.  These are very durable toys.  The first one is looking a little ragged, but it is still holding together and still squeaks.  It has had a lot of use. (He takes it with him every time he goes outside to do potty.)  My dog usually finds out a way to pull the squeakers out of cheaper toys, but not out of his first Outward Hound toy (yet).  Well worth the money, as these hold up so well.  These are not for tiny dogs, but are ideal for an average sized dog to a large dog.  Highly recommended.

title: Quality Ingredients; not as well-liked by my dogs as other brands or other Blue Buffalo recipes
text: I have tried various Blue Buffalo dog foods over the past several years and while the dogs seem to like them, there are other high quality brands they prefer more.  This particular flavor (Flatland Feast with Turkey, Quail & Duck) they didn't seem to be as enthusiastic about as others, but they will eat it in time.  They always have canned wet food too and they always eat that before a kibble type of food anyway.  This is grain free and says it has no artificial preservatives, colors or flavors, no corn, wheat or soy and no chicken/poultry by-product meals.  That's all good.  I did notice that this food does have quite a number of ingredients; however, most of them are either meat, fruit, vegetables or vitamins.  A few of the ingredients I didn't recognize.  The only "bad" ingredient that I found was salt, but doesn't look like there is much.  I did not see any kind of sugar or sweetener which you can find in some dog foods.  (Yes, dogs like sugar too and that is bad for them, just like for us).  From what I know the Blue Buffalo dog foods are manufactured using high specifications, but I could not find where this was made on the bag.  It says it is "made for" the company, which is based in Connecticut.  Have never heard of any problem with this companies products, so I think you are very safe using them.  Most people who I have talked to say this is good, high quality food for the dogs.  Try it, but with the same precaution I always recommend when reviewing dog food; buy a small bag first and see your dog(s) like it.  If they do, then go with a bigger bag.

title: High Quality Raw Food That Dogs Really Like
text: This was an instant hit with my dogs.  The bites are small enough for my nearly toothless chihuahua to eat also.  I have tried some of the other Wellness products and they all seem to be of good quality.  This is a raw product, so is supposedly better for your dogs than cooked dog foods; probably more nutritious.  The company appears to be U.S. based, but some of the manufacturing of the product may be done in Canada, but Canada has high standards for processing dog food, so that should not be of any concern.  Good product and your dogs will most likely like it.  I would get this again.

title: High Quality Food; Celebrity Name on It; Pricey
text: These days there are a lot of choices for premium dog food and my dogs like most of the high quality ones very well.  This one is no exception.  One of my dogs is a small chihuahua who has very few teeth left.  She has trouble chewing dry dog food, so she generally sticks to her wet food, but I saw her eating this one, so obviously she liked it. My bigger hound dog also seems to like it.  It claims to be limited ingredients, but there were over 30 ingredients listed on the bag.  Many of them were vitamins and the main ingredients are meat and vegetables, so maybe that's not a concern.  I did have one minor concern; I looked all over the bag to try and find out where this is manufactured and where the ingredients are sourced from.  I couldn't find it.  The bag says it is distributed by the Natural Balance company in San Francisco.  The food has a 100% satisfaction guarantee and claims to meet AAFCO nutritional guidelines.  It is a grain free product with no artificial flavors or colors.  The bag says the company donates to local animal charities, but it didn't indicate that they donate a percentage; just that they donate.  This is a celebrity dog food (Dick Van Patten's name is on it), so that often makes a food pricier and really the only criticism I can give is that this seems very pricey, even for a premium dog food. It all boils down to what you are willing to pay and whether your dog likes it or not.  I have written quite a few dog food reviews and I always recommend starting with the smallest bag first to see how your dog likes it.  I think your dogs live longer and healthier by feeding them good quality food and this one should work just fine, if they will eat it long term.  Sometimes good to switch to different kinds just to give them some variety.  Just like people, they don't like eating the same thing day after day, especially if they are as spoiled as my dogs are.

title: NICE MAT, JUST A LITTLE TOO SMALL
text: Very cute mat.  Looks better than in the picture.  Nice and absorbant.  The only issue that I had, which kept me from giving it 5 stars is the size.  It's just too small.  My sister says most of the mats that you can buy for pets are too small, so this one is probably typical of the size that you can normally get.  A small rug is what we have been using, but rugs aren't as absorbant of water spills as this mat.  Good mat, but if you want to put both a water bowl and food bowl down, you will need two of these.

title: DOGS LIKED IT OKAY; HARD TO GET OUT OF THE POUCH
text: Both my dogs seemed to like this okay, but they didn't go crazy for it.  Was hoping to use these as a small meal for my little dog, but there isn't much in the pouch and it just isn't quite enough for a meal.  Probably more of a nice topping for a regular meal just to make it more interesting.  It does contain nice chunks of chicken and beef and not a lot additives.  The only issue I had was trying to get it out of the pouch.  It does not squeeze out or shake out easily, so I had to slit it down 3 sides to get it all out and then it sticks to the sides of the pouch, so I had to actually scrape it off the sides of the pouch.  Not that convenient due to the difficult getting it out of the pouch.  This is a product of Thailand, but some recent research I did indicates that standards for dog food production are higher in Thailand than in the U.S., so it should be very safe.  Hartz Mountain has been around a long time and always produced high quality products, so I think you can buy this with confidence.  It seems like it is an item with limited appeal, but it might work to stimulate the appetite of your dog, if he is picky.  Or give him a little snack between meals so that he is no so famished at meal time and ends up eating too fast.

title: HOUND DOG LIKED THEM; CHIHUAHUA DID NOT
text: Got these for my little chihuahua who is old and doesn't have many teeth left.  She loves peanut butter and I thought these would be ideal for her.  I can't get her to eat one.  I finally got her to take one in her mouth, but she spit it out right away.  She apparently didn't like the smell or the taste.  My younger big hound dog did like them and ate them right down, but then he pretty much likes everything.  The two main ingredients are wheat and molasses, so I don't think I would call this a healthy treat.  If you have an older dog who has trouble chewing, this is probably a good occasional treat for them, but I wouldn't feed these regularly or in big quantities.  As the package says they are not intended as a meal replacement.

title: DOGS WERE NOT ENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT IT
text: In my mind, Hill's has always been a good quality premium brand, but I had never used it before, so I thought I would try this for my dogs.  They will eat it, but don't seem very enthusiastic about it.  It probably will never be a favorite of theirs.  My sister said her cats don't like Hill's either.  In all fairness most of the dogs I have had over the years prefer firm food and none have liked the "stew" type of dog food very much, which this is.  At least I gave it a try, but wouldn't get it again.  If your dog likes this type of food, before you buy a case, I would suggest trying a few cans to see if they like it that well.  Just like people, dogs seem to have their food preferences.  This could be a good healthy treat for dogs who normally eat only dry food.

title: CHANCES ARE VERY GOOD YOUR DOG WILL LOVE THEM.
text: These were an instant hit with my dogs.  They are just soft enough for my nearly toothless Chihuahua to eat and yet firm enough so that my larger younger dog chews them instead of just swallowing, as he does with some treats.  These are made in USA and appear to contain quality ingredients.  I can't imagine your dog not liking these.  I would buy these again.  In all fairness, every dog I have ever had loved chicken, except for chopped chicken dog food.  Never have heard of this brand before trying this, but I'll be looking for other products that they make.

title: DOG LOVED IT
text: I put some Proper Toppers on the top of my dog's canned food that he was not eating very well.  You can guess what happened.  He immediately gobbled up all the toppers and left the wet food.  I guess these would be better suited to mixing with dry dog food to add a little extra incentive to eat the dry food.  I have used Honest Kitchen products before, but this is the first time I have tried this particular item.  Their products seem to be very high quality and delicious for the dogs.  I wouldn't hesitate to get this again, as it went over very well.  Made in USA and grain free, which seems like a good thing to me.

title: Good Quality Food that even my dogs seem to like
text: Hill's Science Diet has a reputation for being a top quality dog food, but the acid test is whether or not the dogs like it and will eat it.  Most of the dogs I have owned seem to prefer wet canned food and aren't keen on dry food.  I had one dog for 16 years and another for 17 1/2, so I guess they have done okay on mostly canned food.  The dry is certainly better for them, especially their teeth.  I put some of this down and my hound dog and he started eating it immediately and finished the bowl.  The real test was my Chihuahua.  She rarely will touch dry food, but she was also crunching away on this one, in spite of not having all her teeth.  She seemed to like it.  I did try the dogs again a second day and they didn't seem to want to eat it again that soon.  Maybe it was mainly because it was something new the first time, but it still seems as if they took to this dry food faster than other kinds I have tried.  If you want your dog to eat dry food and/or he or she is already on a dry dog food diet, this is one to try, as I'm sure they will like it.  I think you can feel confident that you are feeding one of the best high quality dog foods if you give them this or any of the Hill's line.  (I think Hills also has a line of canned food too.)  Yes, Hills is probably more expensive that some brands, but if you want your dog around for a long time, feed them good quality food.  Their health will probably be better for it too, so in the long run it could save you in vet bills if they stay healthier, eating a good quality food that some of the stuff on the market.

title: Our cats love this thing
text:
We are big fans of the FUKUMARU line of cat products, and regularly purchase their cardboard box with scratchy inserts for the cats every 2-3 months for several years now (highly recommend!). We bought this particular scratcher as a Christmas gift for the cats this year, but caved and gave it to them early. They've had it maybe two weeks before Christmas and this thing has taken such an beating from two enthusiastic cats that I already need to buy a new one. We started to lay it with the long side on the floor behind the couch and lay one of the scratch board inserts from the other mentioned product alongside to make an extra long scratchy surface and they can't get enough of it.

My only complaint is that the two cardboard panels are not reversible due to how they are shaped with curvy, jutting ends, so the back sides of them never get used. It is such a waste of product, and for $30 it's a steep price for two weeks of claw sharpening. I wish we could just dismantle the item and flip the cardboard panels over so it is like new again for another two weeks.

title: These are amazing - see why low star score
text:
We wanted to tap into our cat's natural predator mode more for their play. These bug toys were an amazing success. Even the lazy cat who won't play was interested in them. We tied a string around two of them and used them on stick toys which made them more fun for the cats to interact with.

Why I gave low stars. For $14, I don't expect the toy to unravel within an hour or two. There are three in a pack and they all unravelled immediately and with little effort. Everything is okay around the head/wings of the bug, but the yarn wrapped body of the bug is absolutely unsecured from the framework except at one attachment point near the head. That means as soon as a kitty claw gets stuck in there, which will happen the moment they touch it, the whole body comes unravelled. For $14 this should not be happening. Really bad manufacturing plan there, and the customer is the one stuck with the bill. Our cats no longer have their toys and we only just bought them.

Be careful your cats don't eat the length of yarn coming off these things, could send them to the vet. I'm going to try to repair them with a little glue, but concerned about the toxicity.

title: Holy smokes, it's amazing!
text:
We have two cats, one of which is a longhair and predominantly white. We have fur on everything, and we own a multitude of gadgets to try to eradicate the hair pollution in our home. I was hesitant to invest in another failed item, but I went with it based on the reviews.

When this thing arrived, I attacked our bed sheets immediately just to test it out. This thing picked up all the fur immediately. My partner came in to see the progress, which took no time at all (comparatively to our previous fur removal tools and long system for cleaning the bed off), and he continued to finish up the top sheet and blanket out of sheer enjoyment that it was actually working. That night, we slept like peaceful kittens in a virtually fur-free bed.

Don't hesitate buying one for your home. I know, much like you I have been let down by so many previous products claiming to do the same, but this one actually works.

title: This litter cabinet has been a game changer!
text:
I've wanted a litter cabinet for a while, but could not rationalize the cost. I live in a 1 bedroom apartment and the only places to put our multi-cat jumbo litterbox is in the living room or the bedroom. Essentially, while we're enjoying a quiet cuddle night and TV dining, our cats are pooping six feet away from us in our line of sight. It's not a very good arrangement.

I finally talked about the benefits of having a litter cabinet with my partner and we agreed to just do it. I will never regret having bought this item. First, we decided to use it as our TV console and it supports our 40 pound flat screen TV with ease (we put it towards the back because we did not install the center divider when assembling, so there was a bit of middle support missing which we were concerned about). The assembly wasn't the easiest, but it came together just fine. I would suggest it as a two person job, if possible, so one person can hold the heavy compressed boards for the other.

As I said above, we veto'd the central divider due to the size of our litterbox and have about 5" clearance between the entry and the edge of the box. I had also bought some corrugated cardboard kitty scratchy pad inserts off Amazon and broke off a portion to stick between the box edge and the entry/exit so help with further getting residual granules off their paws in exit, or if they try to cover their misdeeds by scratching on interior walls or floor, there's a scratchable surface for them, too.

We were concerned about the darkness in there at night and bought some battery charged stick-on motion detector lights off Amazon when we ordered this litter cabinet, and they work perfectly if centered on the entryway. Our cats have gotten used to the light coming on and they actually seem to appreciate the privacy while they powder their noses now. It is working out for us fantastically and we're just grateful to have found this affordable model. It really does just look like a TV console if you didn't know any better, so it fits in our room perfectly.

title: My cats are addicted to these.
text:
We have to resupply the household every few months because my cats go nuts on them. We have a scratchy box in the bedroom, living room, plus a hallway one to deter the cats from scratching in less desirable places. Every time we flip to a fresh side or put a new insert in, they go bonkers. haha They also love to play in them, use them as launching pads when they get the zoomies, etc.

Great investment and furniture saver. I'll keep buying them as long as Fukumaru keeps making them! ♥♥

Side note: We have two cats, and they can go through a package of these every 3 months or so.

title: Warning: These are faulty and not accurate!!!
text:
I bought these hoping they would help me keep an eye on my water. Readings were crazy, did it three times. Took a water sample down to local fish shop and they did the full panel reading for me while I waited 45 minutes. These strips said my water PH was over 7.0 and it was actually under 5.0. That is a huge difference. Every other reading was inaccurate, as well, and far, far off the mark.

Worse, I tried a few more tests with these strips over the next two weeks just to see, and realized every single time I took it, it was giving the exact same reading with only a minor change in nitrites twice.. Out of over ten readings. Every single reading was the same - but not for the fish shop readings which have changed (PH issues fixed now).

Therefore, from my experience with these strips, I have to say that I honestly believe that they are faulty and I would never recommend them to anyone.

title: My cats love this cottage!
text:
[[VIDEOID:80b81776cff1578d1405578a889f7b61]] Let me put this into perspective, we just bought them this lush, super plushy cat perch for larger cats just so that they had more lounge room on the tiers and this thing is like a hotel suite of luxury. We set the cardboard cottage just beside it. Where do the cats want to be? In this cardboard box house. It is their new favorite place, and we are extremely catcentric so there are so many other places they could be, but they love the cardboard house most currently.

On sizing: Now, my cats are both three years old and one is a super fluffy 12 pounds and the other is a rubinesque 15-16 pounder tuxedo torpedo and both fit inside without issue, plenty of space to turn around and lay however they wish - Check the video to see them try to fit in it together. Mostly they play fight over who gets to sit in the house. My advice: don't let a heavier cat aerial jump onto the roof while the other cat is inside or the roof collapses. lol Also worthy of note: they do not seem to overheat in there even with Summer in full swing, I think this is due to the many windows and raised floor which helps with air circulation.

My only complaint on the house itself, despite its super easy assembly and fabulously cute aesthetic, is that the cardboard scratchy pad which makes up the floor appears to have suffered severe carnage and we've only had it for three weeks (this with three other scratching posts available to them). I had to flip it over already, and I don't see inserts for the house available to order. :( So yeah, looks like next month I will have to buy a whole new house just for the scratchy pad. Even so, I give the house five stars.

title: I was very happy to find this product and at its price per ...
text: We received a sample of bonito flakes by another company when at a local pet supply store.  Our kitten went nuts over it.  So, thrifty as I am, looked on amazon for a cheaper alternative to the same product.  I was very happy to find this product and at its price per ounce. My only complaint is that a lot of the flakes are very, very large and curling clusters -not conditioned to small mouths eating it.  We have to break it up by hand really good before serving treats to our kitten, thus getting all fishy smelling at the fingertips in the process.  Other than that, it's great!

title: Fuzz approves of this message

title: ... getting this for my two adult cats and they loved it until it was no longer functional
text: I remembered years and years ago getting this for my two adult cats and they loved it until it was no longer functional.
