text: This ball has become a detrimental part of our household and source of sanity for my boyfriend and I.  Our kitten gets very hyper, and when it is time for him to have his dry food we put it in the SlimCat toy and let him roll it around the living room.  He hoovers up every little crumb, so mess is not an issue (note, you should clean it out regularly to remove food oil residue). It is playtime + snack food, and gives us a bit of a break while he plays with it.  He also rolls it around when empty.  I thought its size might intimidate a 3.5 month old kitten, but he just loves the heck out of this thing.  We will definitely buy another when this one gets worn out eventually.

title: Good, But Not Cold.
text: My kitten liked these, but we had to break them into thirds as they were too difficult for him to eat whole.  I froze most of the package since it required refrigeration and I could not imagine a kitten managing his way through this bag in 2 weeks time.  Side note - kitten does not enjoy them cold, so straight from the fridge is not ideal (he eats his regular wet food cold since we have to refrigerate the can portions, so not sure what the problem is).

title: Possibly Reconsider
text: I loved the idea of this, so that gets the three stars.  The lack of the two other stars is the end result + seller's claims.  First, the seeds do not germinate within 1-2 days, even with cellophane across the top of your container which the insert on the product suggests to expedite seed growth.  6.5 days to germinate, til we saw the tip of 1 sprout poking through the soil.  Once our grass began to grow in, 1 seed packet produced a minimal, spotty patch of grass.  It is mostly random stalks with a lot of space between.  This does not resemble the lush, dense amount of grass as the item advert featured. You would probably need several packets of the seeds to produce that sort of growth. I would not purchase this set again, but rather invest in a bulk bag of wheatgrass seeds to create the dense grasses we had hoped for.

title: Great product
text:
Of all the stuff I've tried to get my bettas interested in, this is the only one that consistently works. They sleep on them, and it's just the right size for a full grown male betta (it's almost twice as big so they have plenty of room to wiggle). It's a bit big for the females, so you have to put it closer to the water's surface to allow them to enjoy it (otherwise the filter flow at the surface will sweep them off it, even just a small flow).

I read a really bad review of one of these that mentioned a metal thing on the end of the leaf (the end you stick into the suction cup) which gathered rust and when she tried to fix it, spewed a bunch of nasty, rusty liquid out into the tank water. Well, either she bought a different product, or the same makers have since resolved that problem and made their product better. The only metal in this product is safely confined within the leaf's plastic, another great feature that makes the leaf bendable. If your bettas keep sliding off the leaf, just tilt it upward a bit; problem solved! If they get stuck or seem like they're always struggling to get off of it, tilt it downward to make it easier (especially for the bigger ones like king bettas).

The suction cup works really well and so far I have not had a single one fall down. In fact it's quite hard to get off to clean the tank; what I do is push the middle of the suction cup toward the tank to flatten it out, then get some tweezers and stick them in between the tank and the suction cup to pry it loose.

title: Good ornament, but not great
text:
I would like this better if my bettas did. None of them seem too fond of it; they do use it occasionally, but mine seem too dumb to notice the hole on top. Whenever I try to feed them via that hole, only one of them consistently notices and eats the food. Thus, I've found it useless as a feeding aid, though my bettas do know it's there.

Part of the problem is there is no way to tether it to anything, so most of the time it floats in circles due to the low flow from my filter. This irritates my fish and they seem less interested in using it. If it could be tethered to the side of the tank, I think they would like it better and probably even sleep in it. I have caught one of them sleeping in there, but not very frequently.

As an ornament, it certainly looks natural and is a great addition to an already-full tank, since it does float. As anything but an ornament, it's not so great. Considering that, I think it's a little overpriced, but maybe some bettas would like it better than others. I would recommend the leaf hammock by far over this item.

title: Somewhat difficult to start up
text:
I am rewriting this review since I returned my earlier purchase (which did not work - same model and brand) and exchanged it for a new one, hoping it was some sort of mechanical defect or broken part. It seems I may have been right (though I am not entirely certain).

The first one just would not work at all. The second one took about as much coaxing as the first, but it did, in the end, start working. I almost couldn't believe my eyes after my titanic battle (which I lost) to get the first one running. I was all but convinced they'd designed a filter that does absolutely nothing.

If you want a filter that's easy to start (just plug it in and go) then don't get this one by any means. The filtration quality is decent for the tank sizes it is recommended for, though for divided tanks, I would recommend having a separate filter for each section. The blue part of the filter (the thing you replace) seems far superior quality to some other filters I have used for smaller tanks. This system also has a component that does NOT need replacing (some kind of BIO-filter where bacteria is intended to grow, I believe). You may notice some Wal-Mart brand activated carbon on the shelves near these - don't buy it. The packaging seems to indicate the carbon is a necessary component, when in fact it is contained inside the blue filter cartridge. The only way you could use it is to buy a media/mesh bag and fill it with carbon, then slide it down inside the filter somewhere.

Another reviewer posted that they have to reset the filter every time the power goes off, and I can attest to that. The only tip I can give for how to get this thing to reliably start up has something to do with the impeller and its assembly. I found that you can pull the assembly up a little bit by putting your finger under the assembly more in the center of the reservoir (as opposed to the sides) - in between the bio-filter and the cartridge. That's the only decent place to lift up on it. When you lift up (with it already primed and then plugged in) you will hear a grinding - as soon as you hear this, shove the whole assembly back down, hard. I think one of the impeller components can spin freely when it's not supposed to (not the impeller itself, but something else). This "jamming" action seems to have jammed that component into its proper place since as soon as I did that, it started working. This must be done EVERY single time the power goes off or you unplug it.

Note: When working, it does take about 20 seconds for the filter to work up to full capacity (with water spewing out at the normal rate). Apparently it can also be baffled by moving the intake tube up and down. However, I am unwilling to try this due to the touchy nature of the impeller assembly. I just know that if I do, it will stop working and I'll have to get it started again.

Overall, I'm not sure it's worth the hassle, but based on some other reviews, and for the price, it is a fairly good filter.

title: Easy to assemble but use a power screwdriver instead of ...
text: Easy to assemble but use a power screwdriver instead of the standard one provided.  A few of the holes didn't line up exactly but were close enough to get everything lined up.  Only issue is that some of the plugs to cover the screws under the shelves don't fit well.  It looks like the holes for the screws are not uniform.  The cats love it and hang out on it all the time.

title: Needed but hard to use
text: This was needed after an ear surgery. My SD  kept trying to pull it down and it was very tight around her neck. She struggled breathing even with me constantly keeping it in the right place on her head. It ended up giving her a rash from the elastic. (She is a seal coat so she didn't have much fur to protect her from the elastic rubbing her head.) There was stretch but not enough. Only one star for noise as that wasn't what we needed it for.

title: Sturdy and fun to play with.
text: I cannot buy enough of these for my 1-year-old puppy! These are the best stuffed animals I have ever found. While there is a small amount of polyfill it's not excessive where you're going to find the dog has ripped it open and snowed all over your house.

title: Lightweight but very functional!
text: This product is awesome as a trail bag it's lightweight so it's not going to be very hot on your fur baby. I was worried that it was going to be a thicker material because the dog it is for has a lot of fur and we live in Florida.

title: A truly indestructible toy for destroyers of all indestructible toys!
text: I have 3 pits and I've had the pineapple since before Christmas 2020, the only thing they've managed to chew off was the tips of the pineapple leaves. I'm quite impressed with the durability of this toy and I plan on buying at least one or two more. I'm able to stuff treats up inside of it and they love playing with it! For dogs that tear up everything I give them I have to give this toy an A+ because my babies destroy every "indestructible" pit proof toy. So far we're doing great! I love the fact that they're not destroying the toy and swallowing the pieces.

title: My dog did not like the flavor.
text: My pop did not like these whatsoever. She needed the probiotic and she will not take them. Which was a shame because she does need to take a probiotic everyday but these treats are not one that she will eat she puts it in her mouth and drops it on the floor.

title: Great for outdoor excursions!
text: It was exactly what I was looking for. I sewed patches on to it that did not Velcro on (there is a lot of Velcro but she had needed patches that didn't quite fit) and she's completely covered now. When she's wearing this vest people do not attempt to touch her. Although this is less comfortable for my SD to lay down with. The neck strap is extremely way too long. I still haven't figured out a good way to shorten it without making it impossible to lengthen again if it's needed.

title: Hands free leash
text:
I absolutely love this leash. Many choices for the length of lead you want to give to your dog. Excellent option to replace a regular leash. This will be the last kind of leash I ever try out.

title: Didn’t purchase- I have important advice for dog owners.
text:
I did not purchase these, however I left 5 stars since it would not be fair to leave less.
As a dog lover of most my life, along the way I have learned some valuable lessons to keep my dogs happy and healthy.
1. Despite the fact that dogs put everything in their mouths, and could possible ingest pieces, the majority of dog toys do not have to meet the same standards as children’s toys do.
2. I shop yard sales for cheap stuffed animals for my dogs that were purchased for a child, which always use much safer materials, and tend to be a better quality as well.
3. I buy a bag of dog squeakers on one for about $7 for 20-30 of them. Using scissors I make a small hole, stuff a squeaker inside, then stitch back up. Takes me about 20 minutes to do this with 5-6 toys. Being a dog toy, no need to have impeccably goof sewing skills. Super easy, and you can add them on each leg, head, body or whatever else you want.
4. At a yard sale I can end up with 20 new to us stuffed animals for my pups for about $15-$20. I once scored a laundry basket filled for $5 and they even threw in the laundry basket.

title: PLEASE TALK TO YOUR VET FIRST!
text:
I can’t stress this enough. Please talk to your dogs vet or canine nutritionalist (not someone affiliated with this company) before adding any new supplements to your dogs diet. Whether you feed commercial dog food and or Especially if you’re already feeding a high raw protein diet such as BARF. What you are feeding your dog may be adequate in certain vitamins and protein, and by adding a full serving of this every single day, your dog over time can build up a toxicity which will put great strain on their vital organs such as kidneys and liver from trying to eliminate the excess it’s body can’t absorb and doesn’t need. Humans can take too many vitamins and or protein and so is the same for a dog.
The Health problems your dog can incur won’t be noticeable to you immediately, it’s building slowly in their body and by the time you notice, sadly it’s usually too late. I’m not against this product and genuinely feel this is a good product for some, but too much of anything every day can make anyone sick.
Do your research and talk to your vet. Your dog is counting on you to be proactive for their health.

text:
I purchased the Pumpkin and Sweet Potato. My two Shepherds will ravenously eat just about anything. Neither one of my boys liked them. And they will gobble up a plain pretzel or cracker if I toss them one on rare occasion. They love plain baked sweet potato’s, carrot raw and cooked, as well as cooked pumpkin, so them turning their adorable noses up at a treat was a shock.
My first impression was the smell of the spices and herbs these contain is too strong. Similar to pumpkin pie and rosemary. Rosemary is known to cause upset tummies in dogs in “large” amounts. I’m certain there is not a large amount of this herb in these treats to cause that and certainly plenty of research went into deciding how much to use, but why add it all all? I let the dogs sniff a bottle I have of fried rosemary and both of them backed away from it. They didn’t like the smell at all. Try this at home folks. Most dogs do not like Rosemary, so I’m baffled as to why this non beneficial herb was added to what could have been a winner.
I often microwave a whole yam or sweet potato and will give my dogs a tablespoon of it here and there for a natural sweet treat and they love it. I don’t add butter, salt, rosemary etc. And why would I need to? Dogs love it just plain! I honestly feel Zukes added these absolutely unnecessary spice to make them smell pleasing to the pet owner. There is no benefit whatsoever for the dogs. I really hope they change the recipe. This could be a real winner if they do. On a side note: I regularly purchase Zukes treats and my dogs love them. Just not this one.

title: It's still easy to remove
text:

title: This is a great tool in theory
text:
This is a great tool in theory, but in actuality it's not all they advertise it to be. For one thing, it is messy. You cannot just shampoo your dog in any room in the house. In fact, I would suggest doing it outside or in the tub if your dog doesn't mind a vacuum sound. The bissell itself is noisy. I put it in my bathroom with an outside door and ran the hose outside to minimize the noise since my dog doesn't like vacuums.

It worked ok and I was cleaner after bathing my lab mix with this than when I bathe her in her pool. She's a good dog so she sits still. I think if you have a dog that you struggle to bathe, this will not work for you at all.

Set up was pretty easy if you read the instructions. I didn't of course and was filling the wrong container with water as it was running out on my floor. Oh well, that's what instructions are for.

The dog is cleaner than what she was so I guess it did do it's job. She's not as clean as a good shampooing and rinse but clean enough to give this 3 stars. I give it 4 stars because I'm didn't get wet like I usually do when I bathe her.

title: Works great a bit messy to set up.

title: Was a Decent trailer.
text:
Edit: unfortunately I am looking at better brands. The wheel bearings have failed on both trailers I have purchased. It feels like I'm riding through sand or mud. The wheels only last 7 months before they turn to crap. They are sealed bearings so it isn't easy to pull them out, clean and grease them. Finding replacement parts is a nightmare. I don't recommend this trailer anymore.

I have owned this trailer for nearly 2 years. I go 100 miles a week with my 25lb Schnauzer. I have gone over dirt, paved bike trail, a field, snow, down many different streets. Never had an issue. One time my bike locked up on me and I fell. The trailer didn't tip over at all. I have never had issues with tipping. Not even a close call.

After 1 year my issue has been the zippers. They are horrible. If you use the screen, after awhile the zipper won't do its job. I had to take it off and then get a long Velcro strip to keep the rain fly closed, since I go in the winter, pretty much all year. I put plastic from a craft store on the sides so wind doesn't come in when it is cold. He also has a self heating pad, that you use for feral cats. They are removed in the summer.

title: Cute!
text: This striped pet onesie is very cute! The sizing is as expected. I think it could also be worn just as pet pajamas and not strictly as a recovery suit.

title: Cute Pet Outfit
text: My daughter recently adopted 2 kittens. Since it's winter now, she's been dressing them in various clothing items for extra warmth. She lives in a rental duplex that was built in the 1950's so it doesn't keep heat well and it's often chilly in her home. The construction of this is good. It fits the kittens. It will definitely help keep them warm this cold season.

title: Litter Genie Compatible
text: These refill bags are compatible with the Litter Genie system. Installation is a little difficult, but once we did it once, I think we won't have any problems next time. The bags are pretty sturdy. In fact they seem sturdier than the original ones. These are definitely an affordable option.

title: Soft & Stylish
text: This pet sweater is soft and stylish. I ordered it for my daughter's new kitten. It's a little big on her, but she does look very cute wearing it. She's less than 3 pounds right now, so we'll try it on her again in a few weeks. The construction seems good. I love the pink leopard print.

title: Good Sizing
text: I ordered these for my daughter's kittens to wear after their sterilization surgery. The sizing is good. The suits are easy to put on them. They helped to keep them from licking or chewing their stitches.

title: The Cats LOVE These!
text: There were 5 cats at the house for Christmas. Two of them live here and my daughter brought her two. These cat tubes were put in their stockings. 4 out of the 5 cats LOVED these. They gobbled up what they were given. The other cat is really picky, so that wasn't a surprise.

title: Adorable!
text: This Reebok dog hoodie is adorable! Archie looks so cute wearing it! The size is perfect. The only comment I have is that the pockets are on his back which looks weird. Of course, he won't be actually using the pockets, but, so it's really not a huge issue.

title: Human Approved, Kitty Not So Much
text: My daughter wanted this cowboy set for her kitten. He's about 3 months old and weighs 3 pounds. My daughter and I thought he looked very cute in it, but he was not very cooperative about letting us dress him. He wears sweaters regularly without any difficulties, so he's used to wearing attire. But he wanted out of this right away. We couldn't even get the glasses on him! The pieces look cute and they are good quality.  We plan to try again soon!

title: Durable!
text: These cat litter bags are very durable. I was pretty impressed that my daughter's kittens were not able to scratch these up at all. The bags fit 2 of the 4 litter boxes that we have. The other 2 have very high sides which made it difficult to fit around. These are significantly thicker than the white trash bags we use.

title: So Cute!
text: My daughter recently adopted a pair of kittens. Sizing has been difficult when it comes to sweater shopping for them. For their Santa pics, we had to get a bearded dragon outfit for the smaller kitty. The other one got a guinea pig one. While this doesn't cover their entire body, it fits much better in the arm holes and chest area than ones designed for cats, or at least better than the ones we can find. For reference, the smaller kitten weighs 2.5 pounds while the larger one weighs 3. The outfit is super soft. Construction seems good. Most importantly, the kittens look adorable in them!

title: Works Pretty Well
text: I am cat sitting for my daughter's kittens. Rather than her bringing a litter box & litter for them, I volunteered to provide them. The kittens are about 3 months old and have been using a paper based pellet. The kittens adjusted to this litter without any problems. I will say that for the first hour or two of having it available to them, it was more like a child's sand table because they were playing with it. But when the time came to use it for the intended purpose, it went well. I am keeping it inside a pet playpen where the kittens are contained at night. Since they are kittens, they have managed to get a lot outside of the litter box. They also tend to splash water out of the water dish and when combined, it gets a bit messy. The litter disintegrates into a paper mache type consistency. It doesn't do much for the covering the smell of their solid waste, but I haven't noticed any smell from their urine. I think this litter has some good potential. I would consider using it for my own cats who currently use microcrystal litter.

title: Kitty Fun!
text: I ordered these cat balls for kitty stockings! There are 20 and at Christmas, we'll have our 3 cats as well as my daughter's 2. Their stockings are small, so 4 balls per cat will help to fill the stockings pretty well. The toys seem comparable to other cat toys that are at the stores. Hopefully these will help keep the cats entertained for a while!

title: Adorable!
text: My daughter just adopted a couple of kittens. They're 3 months old. One of them is very small and weighs just over 2 pounds. For their Christmas photos, my daughter bought a guinea pic outfit for one and had to get a bearded dragon size for the smaller one. This fits the larger one perfectly, but I'm sure he will outgrow it soon. Hopefully the little one will be able to fit it very soon. It's well made and absolutely adorable! Plus it will give them some additional warmth this winter.

title: Cute!
text: My daughter recently adopted a pair of kittens. With the colder months ahead of us, she has been wanting some pet sweaters for them. She lives in an older house and the heating system is good, but the rental house is not well insulated so there are cold spots around. Her kittens are 3 months old now. These sweaters are a bit big on them right now, but I'm sure they'll fit better over the next few months. I ordered the X-Small for them. The quality is pretty good.

title: Cute Pillow!
text: I ordered this cat pillow for one of my senior kitties. The size is good. It's a cute pillow. I have caught her using it a few times. I did find a hole in the cover when I first opened the package. It's on the interior seam. I could easily sew it back up (though it wouldn't look as nice!), but it doesn't seem to be a problem (yet).

title: Pink Cat Collar
text: My daughter has just adopted a pair of kittens. They were spayed/neutered this week. It fits one of the cats, but the other kitten is so tiny that it's way too loose on her. I also tried it on a couple of my adult cats. It fits better on them. However, one of my adult cats was able to get it off (along with her regular collar) within seconds of putting it on her. I like that the collar can be flipped out or down.

title: Kitty Approved
text: My cats do love cardboard scratchers! Their favorite has been one that was shaped like a sofa. For some reason, they like to lounge on their scratchers. This one is comparable to other similar scratchers. It is kitty approved!

title: Well Made
text: My daughter just adopted a pair of kittens. She wants to get started harness training them. The kittens are about 3 months old now and still pretty small. It's too big for the smaller kitten, but it seems to fit the larger one well. The larger kitten is just 3 or 4 pounds. He's growing quickly, so I'm sure he'll grow out of it soon. It's well made and it looks great!

title: Cute!
text: This pet sweater is so cute! It's well made, too. I ordered this for my daughter's kitten. It's a little big now, but I'm sure kitty will be able to fit it better soon.

title: Perfect Size!
text: I ordered this holiday sweater for my daughter's kittens. The kittens are very small. They're about 8 weeks now and both of them are under 2 pounds. I have learned that sizing in the pet clothing is not always consistent, but this one is as I had hoped. It's made well. The edges are secure with no tempting edges that can easily be destroyed by the kitties. Over all, I am very happy with this!

title: Soft!
text: These fleece pajamas are very soft. I really like the grey & pink color combo. I ordered this for my daughter's kitten, but unfortunately it's too big. I have had success with other dog costumes in the XXS size, so I had hopes for this one. The product description has measurements posted to help with sizing, but I was unable to check with my daughter for the cat's measurements. Oh well.... it is well made. There is a drawstring cord to help with the fit. My sister in law has a small dog that will probably fit this. I know she'll look cute in this.

title: Great!
text: My daughter is very eco-friendly. She always uses reusable shopping bags and rarely uses plastic bags. She recently adopted a pair of kittens and was struggling to find bags to use when cleaning out the litter box. She was using a roll of bags designed for use when taking your dog for a walk, but found them to be very thin. She has been very pleased with these. They are significantly stronger and larger than the dog bags. Plus, they are biodegradable.

title: Love that this can Fold Up!
text: I tried a window perch a few years ago for my cats but none of them would use it, so I got rid of it. My daughter just adopted a pair of kittens. Her windows are higher up so sitting on the furniture doesn't allow them much of a view. I love that this can be folded up! She has this on the window in her bedroom. Her bed is against that wall, so the kittens will be okay if for some reason it loses suction. It wasn't too bad putting it together. My husband was able to assemble it for her. She says the kittens like being able to see outside!

title: Very Cute!
text: My daughter recently adopted a pair of kittens. This flower "hat" is too large for them, but we can tell it's going to be very cute on them as soon as they're big enough to wear it.  It seems to be made well. The material is soft.

title: Soft!
text: This pet sweater is soft. I ordered this for my daughter's kitten. It doesn't fit yet, but it seems to be quite nice in both appearance and quality.

title: Kitty Approved
text: My daughter recently adopted a pair of kittens. They're growing, but still can fit in the pocket of this hoodie. The size of this runs a little small. I ordered the XL for my daughter and normally that size would be huge on her. It's actually just a little baggy on her. She usually wears a size L.

title: Great for Travel!
text: My daughter has been fostering a pair of kittens. The fostering didn't work out for her and she will be adopting them as soon as they can be spayed & neutered. She was visiting over the holiday break and brought them with her. This carrier gave them plenty of room for the 2 hour drive. Plus she was able to put a litter box inside. The carrier is easy to set up and take down. There are a pair of handles, but there's also a removable shoulder strap. Yes, it does come with a litter box, but it wasn't ideal. It folds down, but when opened up, it doesn't stay up well. The sides keep folding up a little which actually led to it being spilled while my daughter was driving. We're going to look into alternatives for that. Overall, she is very pleased with it.

title: This Has Been a Huge Hit!
text: My daughter recently adopted a couple of kittens. We brought them with her to our home for Thanksgiving. I had this set up in the living room for them. They immediately discovered it and started playing in it. My daughter  likes it because it can be folded up and doesn't take up a lot of room. The kittens are just 7 weeks old right now and the size is great for them. I think even most adult cats would fit fine in it. This has definitely been a huge hit!

title: Cute Dog Pajamas
text: We have had unusually cold weather this November. My sister's family was visiting, so I ordered this for one of her rat terriers. They have very short hair and get cold easily. The fit was okay. I used the measurements as a guideline, but it was still a little loose. The material is very soft! Gracie looks very cute in it!

title: Cute!
text: My daughter recently adopted a pair of kittens. They're not really into scratching things yet, but they do love hiding in new places. This is a cute cardboard scratcher. It wasn't too difficult to put together. The kitties seem to like it and my daughter likes the way it looks.

title: A Little Smaller Than Expected
text: My daughter just adopted a pair of kittens. They love to cuddle! I ordered this for her so they can cuddle with her. She is a size large. I ordered this in the XL expecting it to be over sized. It's not over sized at all. It fits more like a large on her. She likes baggy & roomy  sweatshirts and this is a more fitted top. It does fit her, but not as an XL should.

title: Too Big for Now
text: My daughter has 2 little kittens. The XS is too big on them for now. They're only 6 weeks old. Hopefully one of them will be able to wear it soon. The construction on the harness and leash seems to be good. I have the impression that it will be durable. My daughter has started putting small sweaters on the kittens which we're hoping will help them with adjusting to this when they're big enough.

title: Nice Smelling
text: This a refill bottle for the odor removing spray that is sold separately. It is a nice smelling spray. It does help with the cat smells in our home, but it doesn't get rid of all the odors associated with the kitties. I like it better than some of the other products out there. I like that it's a plant based product and doesn't contain harmful chemicals.

title: Perfect for Kittens
text: My daughter recently adopted 2 kittens. She was fostering them beforehand and they're just not 6 weeks old. This cat condo is the perfect size for them. One of the kittens can climb up to the top while the smaller one can make it to about 3/4 of the way up. It's very stable when they're playing on it. They both way less than 2 pounds right now, so it's possible that will change as they grow up. It took me about 15 to 20 minutes to put it together. The instructions were clear and easy to follow. My daughter loves the way it looks. The colors are vibrant and cheery. I'm sure she will have to get a larger cat condo by the time they're full grown.

title: Kitten Approved
text: My daughter recently adopted a pair of kittens. She was actually a foster fail. She got them at 3 weeks and had to bottle feed them. They are now 6 weeks old. They have been having fun playing with this wand toy. It's well made and sturdy. It's about twice as long as the kittens are right now, which makes it entertaining to see one of them pulling it around. This is definitely kitten approved

title: Uplifting Scent
text: This odor removing pet spray has a very uplifting scent. The orange smell does a great job of masking pet odors when sprayed into the air. I have also used it to spray on the cat beds. I like that it's plant based. We don't have any carpeting in the house, so I can attest to how it works there. We had to get rid of the carpet because of the pets. At least one of our cats would pee on the carpet. At least this helps with the lingering litter box smells. I wish it was longer lasting!

title: Durable!
text: This treat pouch is very durable. I expect it to last a really long time. It's well made, too. I received the bright yellow one, but I ordered the blue & yellow plaid. The solid yellow is not what I would have ordered if ordering a solid color. There's plenty of room for a few other supplies in addition to treats.

title: More Cat Storage!
text: My husband and I have 3 cats. They don't all get a long, so we like to have a variety of cat friendly surfaces and hiding spots for them. This piece is for my home office. I have placed it in front of the window so a kitty can look outside. Assembly was pretty straight forward, at least in my husband's opinion. It didn't take him too long to put it together, though I did have to assist a few times by holding pieces in place. So far only 1 cat has been in/on it, but she is usually the only one that hangs out in my office.

title: Cat Approved
text: My cats love kickers! These are the right size for my adult/senior cats. It has a zippered pocket for you to insert the catnip. It comes with solid catnip balls, but my cats show no interest in those. I put in some dry catnip leaves and that had a better reaction.

title: Very Cute!
text: I have been looking for decorative kitty collars like this! The ones I found were super expensive. This one is very reasonably priced. The collar stretches to go around the kitty's neck. If the cat was to get it caught on something, it will stretch more so the cat can escape from it easily. The hat is the right size for cats. The set is very cute! Unfortunately, my beautiful black cat was not thrilled about wearing it. It's not even October yet, so I have time to work on it. I plan to put the collar on her for short periods of time so she can get used to it. I also have 2 other cats I can try it on.

title: Cutest Dog Poop Bags!
text: These Juicy Couture Dog Poop bags are the cutest! I love the color/leopard print combinations. The quality is comparable to other doggy bags I've used.

title: Works Well!
text: I am taking care of my daughter's leopard gecko while she's in college. He uses a heat lamp and the bulb burnt out a few days ago. These bulbs work well in his heat lamp. They are much more reasonably priced than what I found at the local chain pet store.

title: Unique and Modern Cat Bed
text: This is a unique and modern cat bed. It is easy to put together. It's sturdy. I have never seen anything like it! It reminds me of a retro egg chair.

title: Clear Panels
text: We have 3 cats and 5 litter boxes. I ordered these clear panels to go on a small litter box with low sides. It comes with adhesive velcro strips to attach to the litter box. You do have to figure out where to put them on the litter box so they don't interfere with one another. I only put 2 on the litter box. Since they're clear, the cats can see out the sides. Because they're on there with velcro, you can easily remove them for clean up.

title: Cute Pet Blanket
text: This is a cute pet blanket. I love the alternating of stripes and paw prints. The blanket is pretty small, but sized right for my cats. The material is soft.

title: Brothy Cat Food
text: This is brothy cat food which is great for providing extra hydration. It reminds me of some of the other broth foods, but it seems to be made with better ingredients. My cats like drinking all the broth, but they do eat a little of the chicken. When they are finished, there's just a pile of shredded chicken left behind.

title: Approved by My 3 Cats!
text: I have seen advertisements for the Kitnip Subscription box, so I was excited to give this box a try. All 3 of my cats approved of it! My girls are all in the 10-14 year range. They all found the toys to be very entertaining. My oldest girl really enjoyed the toy I gave her and it's now super wet from all her kitty slobber. They all enjoyed the treats, too, though the oldest one ate the first one, but not the subsequent one, so I'm not sure what her thoughts are on it. The other 2 ate all of the treats they were given. They even enjoyed the box. I caught one cat sitting in it.

title: Fun for Kitty!
text: This wall mounted laser toy is lots of fun for kitty! I am using the suction cup and have it attached to a glass cabinet and that is working well. There are other hanging pieces if you prefer a more permanent mounting. The laser works well. I usually just touch the button to turn it on and let it do its thing. It seems to move randomly which is good. We used to have one that kept repeating the same pattern and our cat figured it out! We have been entertained by watching the cat play with this!

title: Great Tool!
text: My daughter is working at a camp this summer. She keeps one of these with her at all times. It's easy to use and does a good job of removing ticks. The small, flat size makes it easy to carry with you at all times. She says it's much easier than using tweezers.

title: Treat for Kitty
text: I like giving my senior cat these lickable treats. He loves them! These are easy for him to eat since they're soft and creamy. This box has 24 treats in 3 different flavors. He seems to really enjoy them.

title: Some Assembly Required
text: This is a cute idea! It keeps the cat litter scoop off the floor. Some assembly is required. The finished unit is cute and sturdy.

title: Well Made
text: These replacement cat water dish filters are well made. The edges are securely sewn. I took a gamble on these hoping they would fit in our cat dish, but they don't. However, my husband has been able to fold the edge over a bit to get them in there. I don't think my cats fully appreciate what we do for them!

title: Breakaway Feature Doesn't Work Well
text: These are really cute cat collars. I like the assortment. It's also a great deal! I tested out the breakaway feature on several different ones and I couldn't get it to break away. I thought I must be doing something wrong. I compared it to other collars that we have that do come apart easily.  I had my husband try these and he had to use both hands and full force. It is unlikely that one of our cats would be able to break free from it if he or she was caught on something. It's a shame because they are really cute! I just won't put them on my cats for their safety.

title: Cute!
text: This is a cute piece of furniture for cat owners. Assembly is required. The directions were okay, but could be better. There were a couple of instances where you could put a piece in more than one position. My husband would have to read ahead to see if there were clues so he could install it properly and he wouldn't have to re-do a part. The quality is decent. It does look pretty basic with thin walls. I personally don't think it's nice enough to keep in our living room, but it's fine for upstairs. It will eventually go with my daughter when she graduates from college and gets her own place (and her own cat).

title: Cat Approved
text: It took a few days before the cats started using this. I had to sprinkle some dried catnip onto them. Once I did that, they started scratching on it immediately. They're well made and sturdy. Plus it doesn't leave a mess behind like the cardboard scratchers.

title: Liking it So Far
text: I have 4 cats. I have always wondered about this type of cat litter. I am liking it so far. I am only using this in one litter box. I have it upstairs where our 18 year old kitty lives. He had a stroke about a year ago and doesn't get around easily, so he pretty much lives in our bedroom. He has a litter box in our bathroom. It took about half of the bag to fill his box. We also have to line the area around his box with pee pads. Did I mention that he's mostly blind? Well, he often steps into the box, but doesn't quite step in far enough to get all of his urine inside the litter box. The poor guy! Because of his issues, he would often get the clay litter stuck in his paws. We had to scoop the wet clay litter frequently to limit him stepping into it. He's not getting this stuff stuck to his paws or in between his toe beans. It doesn't seem to be a problem for him to walk on the "used" litter. He still misses the box half the time. There aren't any issues with smell. It does get tracked a little bit, but it's no worse than the clay litter. We find that we have to sweep the area frequently anyway. We're considering switching all of the other litter boxes to this too.

title: So Far So Good
text: My daughter has a couple of pet reptiles. The heating pad for her gecko recently died so she needed a new one. So far so good for this one. She's been keeping a close eye on it to make sure that it doesn't over heat, but the temperature has been in an acceptable range since using this.

title: Soft!
text: I have an elderly cat who basically lives in my bedroom. He had a stroke nearly a year ago and hasn't walked very well since then. I like offering him choices as to where he sleeps. This bed looks very nice and sort of matches my bedroom decor. I have it on the floor so it's very easy for him to get on it. It's soft and warm which is just what he likes!

title: Does the Job
text: I have an elderly cat who still uses his litter box, but he always hangs over the edge and sprays outside the box. I put a pee pad underneath the box and that has solved the problem. I have to change the pads at least once a day. These pads are pretty thin. They're a lot thinner than the previous ones that I used. The size is good for us. They seem to absorb well.

title: So Soft!
text: I am a fan of UnHide blankets. I'm excited that my cat can have one, too! It's definitely a smaller blanket. I don't know how it compares to the smaller UnHide blankets. It's so soft! One of my tuxedo cats has claimed it as her blanket!

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 4 cats, all over the age of 10. They do enjoy tasty cat treats! All 4 of them have been enjoying these soft treats. Usually someone will be picky and snub new treats, but not these treats! This is a single bag of cat treats.

title: Definitely Looks Nicer Than a Litter Box!
text: We have 4 cats and 4 litter boxes. This is replacing the one we have up stairs in the large hallway. It definitely looks nicer than a litter box. However, I'm not sure all 4 of my cats will utilize it. They're not used to enclosed litter boxes. When I opened it and took everything out to put it together, my husband came over and after a quick glance, he said it looked like an Ikea item. He based that on the wooden screws and some of the other steps that are similar to the Ikea way. Set up went smoothly. Pieces were well labeled. Now we're waiting for someone to use it!

title: Excellent!
text: I have an elderly blind cat who still uses his litter box. He steps into his litter box to do his business, but tends to hang his rear right over the edge of the box therefore mostly missing the litter. I started putting a pet pee pad under/around his litter box. These pee pads are an excellent quality. They are a good thickness. The last ones I was using prior to these were so thin and cheap that the quality of these is very noticeable. They have a good absorbency. I am very impressed with these and I recommend them!

title: Works Well
text: This pet grooming tool works well. It has two rows of hook-like fingers that do a good job of removing the under coat. The rows are back to back and one is a little larger than the other. The brush size is a little larger than I like for my pet brushes to be. I have cats and usually smaller ones work a little better.

title: Cute!
text:
See update below!

My cats wear collars with bells so they can announce themselves to one another. I have 4 cats and they don't all get along. If they hear the jingle of the bells, they are on alert. My kids are both in college, so I have a lot of free time on my hands. I tend to change out their collars on a regular basis. These collars are really cute. I love the colors! The flowers were all crushed and bent up when they arrived. The collars are light weight and easy to adjust. They have the breakaway feature that I prefer for their safety. Overall these are okay, but I'm not confident they will be long lasting.

Update 5/21/2022. I have taken these off of my cats. They were always needing to be readjusted. I would fix it and then within hours it would be too loose. When loose, the flowers would get into their food and water dishes. I'm sure it was annoying my fur babies!

title: Non-Irritating!
text: My daughter has been fostering a dog lately. This dog loves to play in the water! So when she takes him hiking, he always plays in the creek. She's been having to give him regular baths because of this habit. This shampoo seems to be non-irritating. It smells great! The dog looks clean afterwards! If only he would stay that way......

title: They're Holding Up Well
text: My daughter has been fostering a pittbull mix. He's quite the chewer. I ordered these for him so he would have plenty of acceptable chew options available to him. These are very sturdy. He likes to chew on them. They're also good for tugging. They're holding up well so far.

title: Easy Grip
text: My daughter has been fostering a Pitbull mix. He chewed through his first leash, the one he came with.This one is a back up for the one she bought. She's finding it easier when she has more than one leash available, too. This one has an easy grip. The padded handle is comfortable to hold on to. The whole thing is very sturdy and durable. The dog has some strength and pulls hard at times and this leash easily stands up to the job. Overall, it's a great leash and when she's done fostering, she will keep this in her trunk for times when she finds loose or stray dogs.

title: Doggie Enrichment Time!
text: My daughter is fostering a dog right now. He's about a year old and has a lot of energy! My daughter thought it would be for him to have some enrichment time. She's been putting dog food into it. He's pretty good at finding the food. She has decided that he needs to be supervised while using it because he has tried chewing on it. He's a pitbull mix and is an aggressive chewer. Overall, she is satisfied with this dog toy.

title: Sturdy
text: My daughter is fostering a dog right now. After 2 days, he chewed through his leash and harness. She had to go buy a new set with her own money. I ordered this for her to use and to have as a backup. She's learning not to keep the leashes out where he can get it! This leash is pretty sturdy and it seems to be plenty durable. It also looks like it would be more difficult for him to chew through this one. He's a 55 pound dog and tends to pull a lot. So far it's working well.

title: Enjoyed by Dog
text: My daughter is fostering a Pitbull Mix. He's quite the chewer! I had high hopes for this toy, but he was able to tear a chunk off of it within 30 minutes. He really enjoyed it for that short amount of time. It does make a squeaky sound. It's a tolerable noise level when compared to other dog toys.

title: Durable!
text: My daughter is fostering a dog right now. It's a nice quality and very durable. We went out driving with them and this was perfect. I have a newish SUV with leather seats. I didn't want the dog to scratch my seats. This fit nicely over the middle row of seats. It attached to the head rests. My daughter was able to sit with the dog. There's a zipper that allowed her to access the seat belt latch. I should have left this in place after we took the dog back to her house. We went out again without the dog and my daughter spilled her drink on the seat! Oh well.......I recommend this for your dogs and your 20 year old daughters!!

title: Loud Squeaks!
text: My daughter is currently fostering a pitbull mix. He likes to chew. He has destroyed a lot of toys so far. We gave him this toy and he's been enjoying it a lot. So far, it's holding up to his chewing without any signs of breaking. It does squeak, which he likes. The squeaking is louder than most squeaky toys. So far, so good!

title: Easy to Set Up
text: This pet playpen is easy to set up and take down. I ordered the large one and it's generously sized. We have an elderly cat who has had some urinary tract issues. He's also got mobility issues from a stroke and tends to walk in circles. On top of that, he's mostly blind. He pretty much lives in our bedroom and does pretty well. For the most part he's doing okay, but there are times when we try to contain him a bit more when we're doing home improvement things upstairs. This playpen is large enough for a small litter box, his food & water and a small bed. Everything is there where he needs it. We line it with washable pee pads so the bottom doesn't get damaged. When he's in there, we don't worry about him getting underfoot during our renovation projects. He doesn't seem to mind it, at least for the short periods of time we've kept him in it. Overall, we are very pleased with this.

title: Perfect Size Portions!
text: I have 4 senior cats. I feed them wet food twice daily. They have dry food available as well. These are the perfect size portions for them. They seem to really like it, even my picky one. I  (well, actually my cats) have tried several different Nacho brand products and overall we have been very pleased.

title: Adequate
text: We have an elderly cat who doesn't always make it all the way into the litter box. We line the area around the litter box with puppy pads such as these. I like the size of these. They're not too big or too small. They seem to be a little thinner than the pads we last used. I also find that they are tricky to unfold. It's hard to find the edge and it is usually stuck to itself. They are fairly absorbent. I would say they're not the best that we've used, but they are adequate.

title: Not Sure About This
text: I have 4 senior cats. We feed them wet food twice daily plus they have access to dry food at all times. They have super smelly poo. I was hoping that this would help. I just haven't been able to get them all to eat this. I started by sprinkling the serving size amount onto the wet food. Then I took a spoon and just kind of rearranged some of the food so the powder wasn't on the top surface. I was able to get 2 of the 4 cats to eat their food. The other 2 absolutely refused. The next time, I completely mixed it into the food. Only 1 cat ate it that day. I like the idea of it. It makes a lot of sense to me. My cats just won't have it!

title: 3 Out of 4 Cats Approve
text: I have 4 cats. 3 out of 4 approved of this dehydrated meat treat. The one that didn't like it, tends to be pretty picky, so she's probably not a reliable source. The pieces are bite size. The cats all seem to like the chicken over the salmon, however, they (except for Miss Picky) will eat the salmon anyway. I like the Nacho brand.

title: Cat Approved
text: My cats eat canned wet food as well as dry food daily. I've been mixing this with their usual dry food to introduce it to them. They seem to like it just fine. I haven't noticed any changes with their litter box habits or deposits since using this. It's probably a little more expensive than I would normally get.

title: Picky Cat Approved
text: I have 4 senior cats. I consider my home a cat retirement home! They all eat wet food twice a daily. They also have access to dry food all day long. We go through a lot of canned cat food as you can imagine. 3 of my kitties aren't too picky, but there is one princess who snubs most offerings. Well, the princess actually likes this! So do the others, but I knew they would. This food comes in a small serving. The consistency is minced which is always good for older cats. It tends to be less messy, too. I will definitely be ordering more of this.

title: Makes Feeding Time Easy!
text: This automatic pet feeder makes feeding time easy! It comes with an AC adapter or it will run on batteries which aren't included. The directions and programming of it were a little complicated, but once you get that figured out, it works well. I have multiple cats so I have it set up for multiple meals/portions per day. It will be helpful when we are out of town. I think it would work really well for homes with just one cat.

title: Works Well
text: I have a blind senior cat who doesn't always contain his bodily functions to the litter box. He will step in the litter box, but his aim is bad. I keep one of these pads underneath his litter box. I put a disposable pad on top of this but under the box. The extra protection makes life easier for me. If the pee pads don't absorb all the urine, then there's this pad underneath. It's really large and covers all around the litter box. It is easy to toss in the washing machine. There are 2 in this set so I can wash one and still have one in use.

title: Works Well
text: I have 4 cats and 4 litter boxes. I scoop each box once a day. This litter works well. It clumps nicely. My cats can produce some very stinky "gifts". It doesn't keep all the smell at bay, but it does help. I would say that this is comparable to a lot of similar cat litter products out there.

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 4 cats. I feed them 2 cans of wet food daily plus they have dry food available all day. The canned food I serve them is usually the size of these cans. This food looks pretty appetizing as far as cat food goes. It's shredded chicken with some gravy. It actually looks like shredded chicken, not like unrecognizable pieces of meat! Of my 4 cats, 2 of them are especially picky. I have offered this to all of them. My non-picky cats seem to love it. My picky cats lick the gravy, but leave the chicken behind. I would definitely purchase this again for my cats.

title: Kitty Approved
text: I didn't realize that these treats were kitten treats when I ordered them. I have 4 senior cats. I have given a few to my cats and they all gobbled them up. From what I read online, it should be fine for my cats to eat these in moderation even though they're not kittens anymore. The bags arrived all sealed. The contents of the one that I have opened so far appeared to be fresh. The cats liked them, so they must taste good.

title: Keeps Kitty Warm
text: I ordered this pet heating pad for my 18 year old cat. We tried using a regular heating pad (for people) but the auto timer turns it off after 2 hours.  We found that we were constantly having to turn it back on for the cat. The timer on this one can last for 48 hours. It took a while to figure out how high to adjust the heat, but we've found a number that isn't too hot, but it is warm enough that you can feel the warmth. It keeps our kitty warm!

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 4 cats and 2 of them have been seen sleeping on (not in) this pet sleeping bag. It's soft and well padded. It doesn't take up as much floor space as a cat pillow bed. I would say that it's kitty approved!

title: Great!
text: We have a 18 year old cat who had a stroke several months ago. Ever since then, he is unable to walk straight and instead leans to the side. He likes to sleep on our bed with us. We have a similar foam stairs and that works pretty well for him. However, with his leaning to the sides, he has fallen off the steps. We now keep pillows on both sides of it to help prevent that. This foam stairs is almost identical to the one we had. The cover is a different color/brand. We have put this directly next to other stairs to create a nice wide set of stairs for him. Now when he veers to the side, he is on another set of stairs instead of falling onto the pillows. So far this stairs is just about half an inch shorter than the other. It doesn't seem to be a problem for him and it's likely it may expand more over time to shorten that gap. This is a must have item and allows him some safe independence. It's easier for him to maneuver on than the rigid hard plastic pet stairs which we have also tried.

title: Decent
text: This cat stocking and assorted toys is a decent set. They aren't what I would call boutique quality but they are acceptable. The cats seem to enjoy the toys that they have been given so far. I'm trying to save the rest for Christmas. The cat hat has way too long of straps which needed to be adjusted. The collar is cute, though I haven't been able to get any of my cats to sit still long enough to put it on.

title: Just What We Wanted!
text: My daughter has a leopard gecko. She has seen other pet owners use similar sets on their geckos on TikTok, so my daughter wanted to give it a try. It's just as expected and just what she wanted. There are 3 different sized pieces so it will accommodate various sized reptiles. The quality seems to be good. The gecko has been tolerant of it, but I'm not sure he is actually enjoying it!

title: Kitties Seem to Like It
text: I have 4 cats and they are fed wet food 2 times a day. In addition, they have dry food available all the time. My 2 least picky cats who will eat just about everything seem to like this cat food. The food consistency is pieces of meat with gravy/liquid. They usually lap up all the liquid and then eat some of the chunks. I have not noticed any difference in their litter box habits after eating this.

title: Just What We Wanted!
text: This set of a small animal hammock & tunnel is just what we wanted! The size is perfect for ferrets. The material is very soft and plush. It comes with metal clips to hang from the cage. Everything seems sturdy and well made.

title: Heavy on the Gravy!
text: I have 4 senior cats. I feed them wet food daily to help ensure that they get enough water. They also have access to dry food. The consistency of this seems more like a thick soup, than minced. My cats seem to like it. It's heavy on the gravy which I know they do like. It doesn't have a strong fishy smell to it, thankfully. One carton is enough for one meal for 2 of my fur babies.

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 4 cats. They all eat wet food twice daily and have access to dry food throughout the day. One of them is particularly picky. I didn't know what to expect with this food. It says it's human grade. I'll just take their word for it. I didn't try it out myself. It's a minced/pureed consistency. One carton is a good amount to split between two fur babies. All of my cats actually like this food, even the picky one. It's kitty approved!

title: Excellent Cat Collars!
text: My cats won't tolerate wearing clothes, so collars are the only way I can add some color and fun to their appearance. It also is a carrier for bells which alert one another the presence of another cat. Sometimes that's good, sometimes it's not. These are breakaway collars. The breakaway feature works perfectly. The collars themselves are soft and velvety. I really like the assortment of colors. These are excellent cat collars!

title: Too Large for the Cage
text: This hammock is pretty nice. It's well made, too. The straps are attached securely to the hammock. It is easy to adjust the straps. The inside is soft and cozy. I ordered this for a pair of ferrets. Unfortunately it is too large for their cage and for them. When they're both inside it, there is too much left over space. They prefer smaller, cozier living quarters.

title: Sturdy
text: My daughter needed something to hold the heat lamp over her leopard gecko's tank. She doesn't have a lot of extra room on the dresser where the tank is, so we selected this stand because it slides under the tank and doesn't require any additional valuable table space. There were no instructions included. I *think* I figured it out. It wasn't easy peasy, but what I did seem logical. It does seem sturdy. I guess only time will tell!

title: Sturdier Than it Looks
text: This pet carrier tote by Vera Bradley is sturdier than it looks. The bag is more rigid which I think works better for the pet. There's a removable pillow on the bottom for comfort. The straps are well secured to the bag. There are large slip pockets on the outside. The material is easy to clean and water repellent. I really like the plaid look.

title: Just as Pictured
text: My cats wear collars all the time. The bells keep them apprised of one another's location. They don't all get along. These collars look just like the pictures. I like the bright pink color. They don't seem to be as high quality as some other collars I've ordered, but they're decent. The breakaway features works well. For the price, I think they're a good deal.

title: Beautiful Cat Collars
text: My cats are my babies! They all wear collars with bells so they can announce their presence to one another. I tend to change their collars seasonally. This pair of collars is beautiful! They have the flower on them which is very girly. The breakaway feature works as intended. They are very nice.

title: Christmas Cat Collars
text: I'm practically an empty nester with 2 kids in college. So what do I do? I dote on my 4 cats. They all wear collars with bells so they can announce their presence to one another - they don't all get along. I started getting them collars for the different holidays. So with Christmas coming soon, they needed Christmas collars. These are cute plaid bow tie collars. They have the breakaway feature which works as it should. The bells jingle as expected. Now I have to decide which 2 will get these collars!

title: Holiday Cat Collars
text: This is a set of 3 cat collars in holiday themes. The holidays include Halloween, Thanksgiving, & Christmas. They are breakaway style and they work well. I like the Thanksgiving and Christmas one, but the Halloween one could be much better. It's orange with black bats (fine) and bloody knives (weird). There are a lot of cute themes for Halloween they could have done! The collars are easy to adjust. The bells jingle like they should. For the price, it's a great deal!

title: Great Quality!
text: One of my cats is going to the vet next week for her yearly checkup and shots. She's a very large cat. Because of Covid, the vet doesn't permit pet owners to go in with the pets. Instead a vet tech comes to the car to fetch your fur child. Well, I have been worrying about this particular cat because she's so heavy. I thought the vet tech would have difficulties managing it. So I saw this, and thought it could be the answer to my problem! It comes flat which is great for storing! You zip the sides of the carrier up and then slide it over the handle. I didn't realize that this is also a backpack, too. Very clever! The interior space isn't very big, but I think my cat will fit in it okay, especially for the short trip to the vet. I did try one of the other cats in it (one that is more easy going) and she did fine in it. There's plenty of storage. Overall, I am very impressed.

title: Adjustable
text: I adopted a couple of senior cats this past spring. One of them doesn't get along with my 2 original cats. I have put one of these collars on the bully cat as well as the 2 original ones in hopes of calming them a bit.As soon as I think that these are working and having a positive effect, there will be a cat fight. So I'm not convinced that they really work. Maybe it's a placebo effect thing. The collars are easy to put on and adjust. They aren't true breakaway collars, but there is not buckle either, so I thin that it would be easy enough for them to escape from it if necessary. You can smell the essential oils on the collar when the cats are near. It's pleasant enough and not annoying. I really wish they would just live in harmony! We'll see.....

title: No Noticeable Scent
text: I've tried many different calming plug-ins. I would like to think that they work. Maybe my cats would be even naughtier if we didn't use one. I don't know. I don't think I've heard any cat attacks this past week. But as soon as I say that, there's bound to be one. There's no noticeable scent to this. It's easy to use. It's quiet. Maybe it's a placebo! I'll update my review if there's any major developments!

title: Interesting Shapes
text: My daughter has a snake and a gecko. They live in separate tanks, of course. But she's always trying to improve their environments. These pieces of driftwood are interesting shapes. The size is good, too. Her reptiles live in large tanks and these pieces will help fill in some of the empty space. She is pleased.

title: Kitty Approved
text: When this arrived, I set it down on a chair in the entry way with a few other items that had arrived. It was knocked to the ground and was partially under the chair, unopened. I found my 17 year old cat rubbing against it and rolling around on the floor. Well, that confirmed the presence of catnip. And so much for saving it for Christmas! I had to open it up and share them with him. The toys are pretty simple and basic for cat toys, but sometimes those are the ones that end up being enjoyed the most. I can say that these are kitty approved!

title: Looks Nice
text: My daughter has a snake. It lives with her in her apartment at college, but she'll bring him home for the holidays. She's setting up a separate tank at our house so she doesn't have to transport his large 60 gallon take when she's home for longer periods of time. This branch looks nice. There are a few minor imperfections, but nothing noticeable when it's in the tank. The glue is visible in person, but in place in the tank it's also not noticeable. Hopefully the snake will like his temporary home.

title: Well Made
text: My daughter owns a couple of pet reptiles. Her leopard gecko only had a heating mat, but she was reading that he should probably have a UVB light, too. This seems to be well made. Nothing about it makes us think that it's cheap. It works as expected. Right now she has it sitting directly on the top of the tank, but she is considering getting one of those lamp stands with the hook on it.

title: Nice Enclosure
text: My daughter recently bought a pet snake. She lives in an apartment away at college, but during school breaks, she will bring him home with her. She has a separate tank set up here for when she visits. This is perfect for transporting the guy home with her. He's perfectly safe in there without fear of escaping. There's enough room for him (at least for now). She is also using it to store him while she's cleaning out his habitat. This set comes with some habitat supplies, so it's not completely bare. It's really a nice set.

title: Excellent Reptile Tank
text: My daughter recently bought a milk snake. He lives in a larger tank (same brand) in her apartment at school. We have set this one up to be ready for when she comes home for holiday breaks. The other tank is so large, we thought it would be easier this way rather than transporting the larger one. She can easily put him in a snake bag or some other escape proof container for the drive home. It arrives flat and well protected. Assembly is easy. The finished tank is very sturdy and secure. There's a little lock on the front. At first I thought it was to keep people from opening the tank, but really it's to keep the creature from escaping! It's really well designed. We have a few more finishing touches to do before he visits.

title: Good for Reptiles
text: My daughter has a couple of reptiles and needed replacement bulbs for them. These are good bulbs and work as expected. She likes that it included a thermometer strip because on of the tanks doesn't have one. She would order this again.

title: Breakaway!
text: I have 4 cats and they all wear collars with bells. The purpose is to announce themselves to us as well as each other. They don't all get along, so the bells are a warning! These are breakaway collars. The breakaway feature works as it should. I really like the little bows on the collars. The bows are petite and much smaller than other collars that I have seen. I like that better. One, because 3 of my cats are girls and it's more girly. Second, I always think that the larger bows would be annoying and get in their way. The collars are adjustable.

title: Not Sure I'm Seeing Any Results
text: I have 4 cats. One of my newest ones likes to bully the two that I've had the longest. I hate that! I want them all to get along! I've tried other brands of similar products. This one as well as the others, I'm not sure that I'm seeing any results. Maybe it would be worse without it? I don't know. They don't have any obvious scent or smell. I have this one in the kitchen area which is one place they all frequent. I do like that it lasts 45 days whereas the other ones I've used are 30 day ones. I'll keep using it until it runs out.

title: No Complaints!
text: My daughter has a milk snake and a Leopard Gecko living with at her apartment at college. Their tanks are pretty large, so for the longer holiday breaks, she plans to transport them in something smaller and keep them in different tanks at our home. Both of their vacation tanks needed water bowls, so the fact that this was a set of 2 is perfect! They are low, shallow dishes, but they're pretty big. My daughter was pleased with their size and quality.

title: Not a Breakaway Collar
text: These are beautiful pet collars. They look great. The rhinestones are securely attached. They're my daughter's school colors, so I thought it would be fun for the cats to wear them during football season. Unfortunately, these are not breakaway collars as described, so my cats won't be wearing them.

title: Cute Pet Tent
text: I have 4 cats and who knows how many cat beds and such. My 17 year old cat has claimed this tent as his own. We have a similar cat tent, but this one comes with a cushion for the bottom whereas the other one has a flat mat. The tent does require some assembly. I couldn't find the strings to tie the sticks together at first, so I started to use the jute. Well, then I found the strings hanging from inside the tent so I was able to make that adjustment. I haven't labeled the little chalkboard yet. No chalk was provided to do so, so I need to track some down. The other tent we have did come with chalk, but I don't think I kept it. The tent is really cute and it makes me happy to see my old kitty sleeping in it.

title: Foam Stairs
text: I have an elderly cat who had a stroke a few months ago. He walks pretty well considering, but he's slow and deliberate. He doesn't jump any more, but still likes to get up on to things. I have a few pet stairs strategically placed around the house for him. These stairs are made entirely of foam. It's compressed when it arrives and has to be given time to expand. The steps are closer together than regular steps and they seem to be closer to a ramp than actual stairs. He's not a very big cat, but it seems that it's not super stable when he's on it. It might be better for a pet that doesn't have any mobility issues, but instead is just too short to reach surfaces on his own.

title: Cute!
text: I probably over indulged my kitties. They have many beds, condos, perches, etc. This is their first tent and it's been a hit! It requires assembly. The instructions were just so-so. They did have some diagrams which helped me to figure out how to put it together. The finished tent is very cute! One of my kitties has claimed it as her own and can be found sleeping in it nightly.

title: Adjusts Easily
text: This is a beautiful cat collar. It adjusts easily to fit the neck size. The breakaway feature works well and as expected. There's a little bell on the collar so my cat can announce his presence to the other cats when he enters the room. I love the Japanese print on the fabric!

title: Cute Kitty Condo!
text: This is a cute kitty condo and doesn't look like the typical, carpeted ones. It has a more modern look and  aesthetically fits nicely in my living room. It does require some assembly. I did have to help hold the sides in piece while my husband screwed it together. There are 3 levels for kitty to perch on. There are furry pads on each level for comfort.

title: Beautiful Cat Collar
text: This is a beautiful cat collar! It's adjustable so you can customize the fit. The bell is cute and unique. I make all of my cats were collars with bells so they can announce themselves to one another. Otherwise, one of them constantly attacks the others by surprise. It's a warning system! This collar also has the breakaway feature, which I prefer for their own safety. The breakaway feature works as it's supposed to. I really do like this collar a lot! It's very different from most other cat collars.

title: Affordable
text: My daughter recently adopted a pet snake. She wanted some driftwood to put in the tank. She found the ones in the local shops to be much more expensive, so this is definitely a more affordable option. The overall size of hers is good. And we knew that the pieces would be different from the pictures. However, ours is pretty flat. The one in the picture extends up quite a bit, so we were a little disappointed with the one we got. It looks pretty lost in her 50 gallon tank! We were hoping for one with some height to take up some of the empty space in the tank.  The quality is fine. Just not what we were hoping for.

title: Great for Pet Travel
text: My daughter is taking her leopard gecko to live with her in her apartment this year at college. She has a tank set up at the apartment and is keeping his original tank at our home. When she comes for long visits such as Christmas break, she will bring him home with her. She needed a carrier of some type for that task. Several that I looked at had a fuzzy, fake fur type floor. I didn't like that idea because it seemed like it would be difficult to keep clean. This one is easy to keep clean. It has a removable pad and the surfaces are washable. There's a large vinyl window so you can keep an eye on your creature. The only thing I don't like about it is that I found the zipper to be a little difficult to use. I don't think it will come undone or anything. It's just  the position of the angle of the zipper makes it hard to move the zipper to zip or unzip. Other than that, it's great!

title: Easter Themed Cat Collars
text: I have 4 cats. I'm on my way to being that crazy cat lady. My husband says I'm already there. I *would* dress up my kitties in costumes or cat attire *if* they would let me. So I'm basically limited to collars. These are Easter themed ones. They are cute and cheery. The breakaway feature works well as intended. The bells are a necessity at my house so the cats can announce themselves to one another when they enter the room. We have some that don't get along with one another, so this warning system allows them to reach higher ground if necessary.

title: Cute!
text: I recently adopted an all black kitty. We often call her a vampire because of her fangs. She was not very cooperative when we tried this on her. There are Velcro straps that you connect under the front arms to position it in place. It was similar to a harness in how you put it on and how she reacted to it. She started backing up and trying to get out of it. For the moment or two she had it on, she did look cute!! I may try again on Halloween!

title: Cracked Lid
text: I have 4 cats and we go through a lot of cat litter. This size of container would last less than a week at our house. It works fine and is comparable to other cat litters that I purchase, though it does cost more. When this arrived, I noticed cat litter spilling out of the box on the front porch. I opened it and discovered the lid had cracked and caused about a quarter of the litter to spill out. I was able to dump the loose litter directly into one of the cat boxes so it didn't go to waste. It clumps well. Odor seems to be controlled.

title: Pretty Kitties!
text: I have 4 cats. They all wear collars. Three of my cats are girls, so I was excited to give these a try. Only 2 of the 3 girly collars have the breakaway feature. The other with all of the flowers has to be tied. The pink sheer ribbon is pretty. The collars care adjustable. My cats don't seem too bothered by them.

title: Eco Friendly
text: I have an elderly male cat who sometimes (frequently) misses the litter box. I was keeping the area surrounding his primary litter box with several pee pads. I saw these and was excited to try this instead. It's definitely more eco-friendly! The size of this pad is large enough to fit underneath his litter box and cover the areas he most often "hits" when he misses. He usually misses a few times a week, so there's time to wash them in between. With 2, I can always have a clean one ready to go. This washes well. It does the job! I only wish it didn't have the dog theme decorations!

title: What a Deal!
text: What a deal! I am very surprised to see so many cat collars for such a low price! The collars are good and work well.  We have 4 cats and they all wear collars. The main purpose is that they can announce their presence to one another because of the bells. One of the cats likes to pounce and attack the others, so this gives them a warning. They have the breakaway feature that I like. Every once in a while, I will find a collar on the floor somewhere and have to track down the naked kitty!

title: Nice Size Portions
text: I feed my 4 cats wet food daily and they have dry food available to them as well. My cats range from 8 years to 17 years. I thought this would be a nice addition since it's considered a "topper". My senior cats seem to enjoy gravy over their wet food. This has been more than a gravy like I expected. There are a lot of meat bits in it. I've been offering this to my newest babies (17 & 9). Neither of them have been interested in it when it's offered to them. Usually I notice that some of it has been eaten when I'm collecting the bowls and putting out fresh food. I like the idea of the immunity support. I'm sure my cats can use it! I did want to say that I only received one box of 8 pouches. The box was shipped inside a padded envelope. The box was crushed and there was some leakage from a couple of the pouches.

title: Breakaway Collars
text: I have 4 cats and they don't all get along. They're all indoor cats, but I make them wear collars with little bells on them so they can announce themselves so they don't surprise one another.  The 17 year old male wears bow tie collars such as these. He looks quite dapper in them! These collars are a good quality. The breakaway feature works well. It was easy to adjust the collar to fit our old kitty. I am pleased with these.

title: Kitty Approved
text: I like using smaller portion foods like the appetizers or soups for in between meals. My cats get dry food all day. Then they get canned food in the morning and evening. Sometimes they try to tell me that they need canned food at other times, so about once a day, I will give them this or something similar. This looks palatable compared to some wet cat food. It actually looks like quality food. The kitties like it, so it has their approval. I feel good about giving them these.

title: Smelly, But the Cats Like It
text: These cat food cans are large. I would say they are 2 serving sized. Two of my cats like this food. Of the ones that don't, one doesn't eat much wet food and the other doesn't seem to like seafood.  It's kind of a mix between pate and flakes. It is packed tightly in the can, so it comes out like a pate, but if you take the fork to it, it breaks into the flakes. It's very smelly.
