We don't usually serve the seafood foods to the cats, so we're not used to the strong fishy smell.  It seems to be a good quality cat food.

title: Large Size
text: This is my first time with a stainless steel litter pan. This is larger than I expected. I was able to replace 2 smaller plastic ones with this one. I have 4 senior cats. Most of them don't have any difficulties stepping in and out of the litter boxes, but the oldest one had a stroke a few months ago. He's getting better, but he does have problems climbing in and out of the regular ones at times. He spends most of his time upstairs, so this is the one he uses the most now. The height is high enough to keep most of the litter inside, but easy enough for him to get in and out. Wet litter does stick a bit to the surface, but it is easier to scoop out than the plastic ones. The material doesn't absorb the smell like the plastic ones either. So far, we are pleased with it.

title: Nice Reptile Cage
text: My daughter has a leopard gecko. She's a college student so the gecko lives at home and I take care of him. Daughter is moving into an apartment in a few weeks and is taking the gecko with her!! He's currently in a tank, but the bottom has a crack in it. We don't want to risk breaking it further, so it's going to remain at home. Plus, he will have a place to live when they come home for holidays and breaks. This tank will be his new home. It arrived safely. All of the pieces were wrapped individually and packed well. It wasn't too difficult to put the tank together. The directions were easy to follow. My daughter is especially excited about the lid to the tank. It's much "fancier" than the one she has at home. The gecko is pretty low key and not an escape risk, but if we had a reptile with a greater risk, we would feel safe with this. After we put it together, we did take it apart and packed it back up. We figured it would be easier to transport that way.

title: Reptile Carpet
text: This reptile carpet comes in a roll. You can cut it to the size you need. My daughter is setting up a tank with the intent on adopting a snake this fall. She said it was easy enough to trim. She did use heavy duty scissors to do the job. It pretty much looks like the picture.

title: Works Well
text: These pee pads are small, but they work well. I have an elderly cat who sometimes misses while in the litter box. I keep a pad on the outside where he misses the most frequently. They absorb the urine fine. These are definitely a better deal than the name brands that I was buying before.

title: Fits In the Corner
text: This food dish fits in the corner nicely. It's larger than I anticipated, but that's not a problem. My daughter has a leopard gecko that she has owned for a few years. She's moving into an apartment next year and wants to take him with her. The current tank he's in is old and fragile. So rather than move the tank, we've gotten a new one which needs to be set up. This will be used for water. She plans to bring him home over the long school breaks such as Christmas, so he will still need the tank at home. She is very pleased with this dish. It's very sturdy and feels durable. It's a great addition to the habitat.

title: I Think It's Helping
text: I recently adopted 2 senior cats whose owner died. That makes the total of 4 at my house. The 2 original ones aren't accepting of these new cats. One of the new ones has been attacking the original ones. I've been trying everything to create a more peaceful home. I have the calming plug in things in a few different rooms. I have a spray that I use. I keep the cats separated at night to avoid middle of the night fights. This is a set of 3 collars. I have one on the new bully and the original one who seems to hiss and growl the most. They've been wearing them for about a week. The collars are easy to adjust the fit. I personally like the purple color. There's minimal smell to them. The bully cat was wearing a hemp calming collar for a while but that had a noticeable scent every time I was close to her. In the time since we've been wearing these, the bully has been able to spend longer periods of time in the living room where the originals hang out. We've still had some fighting, but I take it as a success that bully cat can spend hours in the same room and coexist. I know the assimilation of cats can take a really long time, so I'm pleased with the progress. Also, these collars are so much more affordable than some of the other ones out there and you get 3 of them! I do wish that they were breakaway style though.

title: Snubbed By My Cats
text: I have picky cats. They eat canned food a couple of times a day. I often buy special cat gravy to pour over their food and they love it. I thought they would like this, too. I made it into a gravy and poured it over their food. The cats all snubbed it. I offered it a couple of times to them with the same reaction. I passed it on to a friend who has an elderly dog. He seems to like it. My friend says she's noticed an improvement in his gait. I can't fault the broth because my picky cats turned up their noses at it. I am glad that my friend's dog is liking it.

title: Nice Cat Toys
text: There's something about Nepalese wool cat toys that my cats just love! I purchased a couple of similar toys for my cats a couple of years ago and it was a big hit! I've caught at least two of my cats playing with these just this afternoon. I don't even have to add catnip to them! These are approved by my kitties!

title: Fun for Kitty
text: One of my cats attacks the others, so I play with her to help her expend her energy. She likes laser pointers a lot, so I usually keep one in my pocket so I can entertain her throughout the day. This one is shaped like a kitty paw, complete with toe beans. There are several different options. The basic laser point is my preferred, but I do switch to the happy face or butterfly to change it up sometimes. Batteries aren't included.

title: Cute Collars!
text: I have 4 cats. One pair gets along nicely. The other pair tolerate one another most of the time. Neither pair gets along with the other pair. Because of this, collars with bells are a must! It reduces the number of surprise attacks and allows the cats to be on guard. These collar are very cute. The breakaway feature works as expected.

title: Dual Purpose
text: This piece has a dual purpose. Not only is it a cat perch, but it also provides much needed storage. This arrived flat and required assembly. It took my husband no more than 30 minutes to put it together. We have put it in the bedroom next to the window. Our elderly cat discovered it this morning and used it to look out the window. He can't climb or jump very well, so the steps are quite useful. The shelves are too small to hold books upright, so I had to put them on their sides. I was expecting that for the hardback titles, but it was also true for the paperback ones. The box was damaged upon arrival and one of the pieces of wood was chipped. It didn't interfere with assembly. We've put that side against the wall so it's not in view.

title: Set of 2
text: This is a set of 2 dispensers for pet medicines. One is for pills and the other is for liquids. The pill dispenser is just too big for the pill size that my cat takes. The pill would just fall out of the holder. We currently don't have any liquid medicines for the cats, so I couldn't try that one out, but it seems to be pretty standard and I don't see there being any problems.

title: Darling Cat Collars
text: These are darling cat collars! There are 2 collars in this set - one has a bow and the other one has a flower. The breakaway feature works nicely. They seem to be made well. I make my cats wear collars with bells on them so they can't sneak up on one another.

title: So Far It Hasn't Worked for Us
text: I've been trying this pill dispenser for a few days now and so far it hasn't worked for us. We have a 17 year old cat with hyper-thyroidism. His pills are pretty small and they aren't coated, so they start dissolving when they come in contact with water. Every time that I have used this, the water in the syringe goes into his throat and mouth, but it doesn't dislodge the pill. I think it works, then I look at it and the pill is still there. Then since it's been in contact with water, it's starting to crumble and disintegrate. My experiences may not be the same as yours. I am leaning toward blaming the pill not the gadget. It may be a while before we have a different pill or liquid medicine to try.

title: Slightly Cooling
text: I often spot one of my cats spread out on the cool tile floor, so I thought they might enjoy this cooling blanket. I've had it out for several days and I have yet to see any of my cats lounging on it. I did find a hair ball on one this morning, so they know it's there! I am a fan of cooling blankets and I have one for myself. These are a good size for the cats. They remind me of a baby's blanket. I just finished washing the one with the hair ball and it washed well.

title: Fun Themed Kitty Collars
text: These are fun themed kitty collars. The breakaway feature works well. The colors are vibrant. They seem to be sturdy and well made.  My tuxedo kitties look sharp in these!

title: Cute Breakaway Collars
text: These are cute breakaway collars for kitties. The floral fabric print is darling. The breakaway closure works as it should. The items are durable and well made.

title: Easy to Get My Cat Inside
text: I have had to take my oldest cat to the vet a lot recently. He had a stroke a couple of weeks ago and has shown signs of some back pain as a result. Our other pet carriers have entrances on the ends only. I didn't want to push him in that way. This one has a large enough opening on the top and a full length one on the side. Both of those options are easier for getting him inside without hurting him. The carrier is small. My largest cat will not be able to fit into it. I like that it can be collapsed to a flat position for storage. It seems to be made well. There's a comfortable padded bottom. I am pleased.

title: Sturdy
text: I ordered this pet feeder because it has a large water capacity. My cats drink a lot of water and I'm constantly refilling the water bowls. This one has been out for days and I haven't had to refill it yet. I set it up as a long straight feeding station, though I am thinking about changing it to an angle. The bowls are slightly raised. I like that the shape of the water dish is fixed so the cat's whiskers don't get wet. I'm not sure if my cats appreciate that or not, but if it's something that bothers them, then this would be a solution for that. Overall, it's a sturdy design.

title: Works Well
text: I already had a pair of the corner self groomer pieces, but my cats love it so much, I wanted some more in the house. I recently adopted a senior cat that was declawed, so I know he especially appreciates these. As for the glove, that has also been a hit. It's much easier than using a brush. The glove is right handed and just looks kind of cheap, but boy, does it work! My cats let me brush them with the glove a lot longer than they do with a brush.

title: Easy to Clean!
text: I have 4 cats who are messy eaters. This silicone food mat is a big help! It catches food and water spills nicely. There's a raised edge to help contain spills. It's easy to clean. I am very pleased with it.

title: Great Handles!
text: These cat teaser toys have great handles. A lot of interactive cat toys look promising but their handles are either too short or too flimsy. The handle on these is neither! Plus since the handle telescopes, you can shorten it when you're putting it away after kitty play time. My kitties have been enjoying their new toys.

title: Soft
text: I really like this waterproof pet blanket. A lot of waterproof items aren't soft, but this one is. I have 4 cats. We get a lot of hairballs in addition to some vomiting. I feel better having this on the good furniture knowing that it will keep the furniture dry underneath.

title: Helps With the Smell!
text: We just recently adopted 2 elderly cats from the shelter. One of our previous cats isn't happy about it and has been showing her displeasure by not using the any of the 4 litter boxes we have in the house. This lemon enzyme spray as been helpful with the smell. The strength of the smell is down quite a bit. It's not altogether gone, but it's improved.

title: Sturdy
text: We have 4 litter boxes in the house. I clean them daily. We use traditional clumping scoop litter. When it gets wet, it hardens to the litter tray. If the scoop isn't sturdy enough, it can't get all of the hardened litter out. I have broken scoops trying to clean out the boxes! This one is sturdy. It's actually sturdier than I expected. It can get the harden litter out. It doesn't flex when being used either. I like the holder part because it keeps the scoop off the floor. While I do like pink, I would prefer a more neutral color.

title: Works Great!
text: We just adopted 2 more cats for a total of 4 now. One of the new ones is 17 years old and has health issues. He came with a 9 year old one who likes to bully our original cats. For those reasons, we are keeping the new ones separated from the original ones most of the time. That means we have 2 feeding stations. The original  kitties eat in the kitchen on tile floor, but the new ones are eating upstairs  on carpet. This feeding mat is perfect! The size is large enough for their food bowls and water dish. I like the raised edges on this. It's easy to clean. I'm very pleased with it.

title: Sturdier Than It Looks
text: We have an elderly cat who has difficulties jumping up on furniture. These stairs have been very helpful for the old guy. He now jumps up on our bed every night. Assembly is required. The instructions are basically only diagrams. I put it together, but found the instructions not very helpful in doing so. I also had to get help from my husband to get that last tube into place so it was straight. It's very sturdy and much sturdier than it looks in the pictures.

title: A Kitty Favorite!
text: I have 4 cats, ages 8 through 17. These packets of Delectable Savory Broths Lickable Cat Treats are a kitty favorite at my house. We recently adopted the 17 year old from the shelter. He was underweight and we could feel his spine every time we petted him. I pretty much give him food whenever he wants it. These treats are his favorite! It looks like quality food. He laps this up pretty quickly. In the month that we've owned him, he has gained over a pound and his spine is not quite as pronounced. He chirps when he sees me bringing one of these packets to him!!! The only complaint that I have is that it's difficult to get all of the broth out. There's always some stuck to the sides that is hard to get out.

title: Good Hiding Spot
text: My daughter has a leopard gecko. She's planning on taking him with her to the apartment she's going to live in at college in the fall. But she wants to bring him home over long breaks. Her plan is to have a tank set up at each location rather than transporting the large tanks back and forth. She'll get a travel container for the drives. She has set this up in her home tank for now to try it out. It's a good piece. The gecko has found a good hiding spot in it. We don't see him climbing around it, but he does have to climb it to get to the hiding spot. My daughter is pleased with the quality of it.

title: So Cute!
text: These patriotic cat collars are so cute! I have 4 cats, so I need to get 2 more collars. These are breakaway styled and that works well. In addition to the bows & bells, there's also a star shaped flag charm hanging from it. My kitties are going to look awesome for the 4th of July this year!

title: Great Filters!
text: These are great replacement filters for our cat water fountain. They fit perfectly and look just like the original ones. Nice affordable option!

title: Comfortable Handle
text: I really like the bright color of this dog leash. It's fun and cheery. It's very sturdy and doesn't give when being pulled. The hardware is strong and easy to attach to the dog's collar securely. The handle has a foam grip which is very comfortable. Great leash!

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 4 cats and they all eat some type of wet food. I have been using these packets by pouring over pate' style food that doesn't have any gravy already. Then I sprinkle some dry food on top. My least 2 kitties have been very pleased with this offering. I haven't even offered it to my pickier cats yet. The packets are easy to tear open and the gravy spills out pretty well. It's a great way to spruce up their food!

title: Sturdy Leash
text: This is a very sturdy leash. The rope is pretty thick and doesn't give. The handle is covered in foam which is comfortable to grip. Plus, I really like the pretty blue color.

title: Great Replacement Bells
text: I just added 2 more cats to my family for a total of 4. The new ones don't get along yet with the old ones. I think the old ones are more resistant to the presence of the new ones. They all wear breakable collars with bells so they can announce themselves and we can avoid surprise encounters. At least one of my cats is notorious for getting her bell into her wet food as she eats. As it dries, it affects the bell and eventually the bell will stop making noise. I've tried cleaning the bells at times, but it's not always successful. And there have been a few times when bells just break off and get lost. Now, I can easily replace the bells. They are a little tricky to hang onto the collars just because they are small. It's similar to fastening jewelry. The bells are slightly larger than the ones that are originally on the collars and that actually makes a slightly different sound. That could be helpful in actually identifying the cat one day if we pay attention to the noises that the bells make. Overall, I am pleased with these bells.

title: Beautiful Collar
text: I didn't realize when I ordered this that it wasn't a breakaway collar. Unfortunately it's no one, so I probably won't be putting it on my cat. I recently adopted a 17 year old male cat and thought this black bow tie would like sharp on him. Well, it does look good, but removed it shortly afterwards. The quality is good, too.

title: Better Than I Expected!
text: My daughter is a college student. She is moving into an apartment this fall. She and her roommate want to get a pet snake. She's a wildlife biology student and would have all kinds of pets if she could! My husband's first reaction to this when we were opening it was that it was fairly serious for a reptile tank. The size is huge! All of the glass pieces were packaged very well. I was concerned about damage during delivery, but everything was fine. The directions were straight forward and clear. We only partially assembled it because we decided it would be easier to transport it to her apartment in the box and put it together onsite. We did put a few of the glass panels into place, but we did not attach them together. We thoroughly examined all the pieces. The lid has latches that slide back to open the panel. There's a lock on the tank so if you want to keep others out if it, you can. We were really impressed with the quality of this.

title: Small Size
text: This pet carrier is a small size. 3 out of my 4 cats can fit in it. The other one needs a larger one. I found one of the ends to be difficult to zip. It did finally zip, but I had to work it. Another thing, the bottom isn't very stable. When carrying my 8 pound cat in it, the base practically collapsed and the sides folded in a bit. My cat didn't seem to mind, but I didn't like that. There is a little side window. When I took my cat to the vet, I opened the window and put my hand inside to pet him to help calm him. It did help, but he was able to get out of it. Overall, this is just okay.

title: Simple Design
text: We recently adopted a senior kitty and he needed a collar. The breakaway feature works well without any problems. The design is simple and neutral. It doesn't have a bell, so I have ordered some so I can add one to his collar. With 4 cats in my home, I like the bells so they can announce their presence to the other cats rather than sneak up on them. The overall quality is good.

title: Fun to Watch
text: I have 4 cats. They're all seniors, but still playful. They have all had fun watching the fish flop around, but no one has been seen actually playing with them. The fish are large and realistic looking. Their movements are pretty realistic, too. But so far, there's been minimal interest in playing with them.

title: Cats Seem to Like It
text: We adopted 2 more cats last week. Since they came to the shelter, we didn't know what they were eating before, so when this arrived shortly after they did, I thought I would try it. The cats also get canned wet food a few times a day, too. Both of the cats are seniors and one is underweight. The cats have been eating this without any complaints or issues. I haven't seen any signs of tummy distress in the litter box nor has there been any vomiting. The cats seem to like it!

title: Easy to Assemble
text: I recently adopted 2 cats from the shelter making our total of cats 4. They don't always get along, so I like having a variety of places for them to seek refuge from at a variety of heights. This one is darling! The flower design is unique and fun. It didn't take long for one of the kitties to jump up on it. Then I was surprised to see her playing with the dangling toy, too! I was able to put this together in just a few minutes on my own. It's sturdy and stable. The flower part isn't very large, but adequate. Overall, this has been kitty approved!

title: Cat Approved
text: I'm bad about giving my cats new toys all the time. These ones are so cute! I wasn't sure either of my girls were interested in them, but I've started seeing the one with the stick attached to it being left around the house. This morning it was half way up the stairs! That's the biggest indicator to me that it's cat approved!

title: Good Quality
text: My husband owns his own company and works from home. He has to ship supplies to customers every now and then. These boxes are a good quality. They are comparable to other boxes. The size is good for smaller shipments. Overall, they are great boxes!

title: Seems to Be Good
text: This turtle food seems to be good. It's getting eaten. I haven't seen any lingering around after feedings. It looks like other turtle foods.

title: Cute Kitty Toys
text: I have 2 cats who love to play with toys. This is a fun assortment of kitty toys. They're all cute! The toys are durable and hold up to lots of play and clawing.

title: Fun Assortment of Kitty Toys
text: This is a fun assortment of kitty toys. My cats weren't that interested in them at first. They usually are very interested in catnip. I sprinkled some more cat nip on them and that worked. The toys are pretty durable and should hold up to lots of playtime.

title: Nice Cat Collars
text: I saw these cat collars and thought they would be just perfect for my cats over Christmas. I like the plaid print with matching bows. Christmas is still several months away, but I did go ahead and try them out. The breakaway feature works as expected. The collars are easy to adjust to fit. The bells jingle as they should. I am more than pleased with these.

title: It Works!
text: It works! Well, there isn't much too it, it's a cardboard cat scratcher. My cats use it to scratch on, therefore it has met my expectations. The cardboard pieces that come off during scratching seem to land in the areas between the cylindrical cardboard tubes and don't end up on the floor like other scratchers, so in that regards, it exceeded my expectations. There are 2 cardboard scratchers in the set. Each one comes with a small baggy of catnip.

title: Cat Food
text: I have 3 senior cats and they eat primarily canned food though they have dry food available throughout the day. One reason I like the canned food is that it has so much moisture.  I wouldn't call it dry, but it's not as wet and moist as most canned cat foods.  It's a pate and as far as canned cat food goes, it doesn't look very appetizing. I have offered it to my cats several times. They seem interested, but I haven't seen them eat more than a few licks or bites. However, on one occasion, someone's bowl was completely empty. But most of the time, I end up throwing it out. The list of ingredients looks good. I will continue to offer it to my cats from time to time.

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 3 senior kitties. They are fed wet food a couple of times each day, but have access to dry food all day long. Someone got into this bag of food before I even opened it. It must smell good even through the bag! I've been mixing a little of this with their Purina One cat food. Everyone seems to be eating it. I haven't noticed any changes (good or bad) with the contents of their litter boxes. My cats can be pretty picky when it comes to wet food, but they are usually more accepting of dry food. Since they're eating it, it must be Kitty Approved!

title: Cute!
text: My cats sneak up on one another, so we make them wear collars with bells on them to announce themselves when they enter the room. This collar is really cute. The breakaway feature works as it should. The bow is a nice feature that most collars don't have.

title: Cute Collars
text: I have 3 older female cats. None of them get along, but 2 of them at least tolerate one another. Collars with bells are a must for some amount of sanity on my part. It keeps the cats from sneaking up on one another and reduces the fighting and hissing. These are cute collars. I will only put breakaway collars on my girls for safety. I will find a naked kitty every now and then and have to track down the missing collar. The breakaway feature works well on these collars.

title: Small, But Cute
text: I have 3 cats and they love sleeping in raised hammocks. This one requires some assembly. It's not difficult. I was able to do it on my own in just a few minutes. One of my cats didn't like it for some reason and peed in it shortly after I assembled it. Luckily, the hammock is easy to remove and I tossed it in the washing machine. It came out fine and was able to go back on without any trouble.  The surface area of the hammock is kind of small. Only 2 of my 3 cats fit in it. They don't really play with the toys that are attached. I like the pink color!

title: Great Product!
text: We have an assortment of bird feeders in our back yard. One of them is a cage/basket designed for suet. These suet blocks fit well in it. They are comparable to other suet that I have purchased at the store. Some weeks, the birds eat more suet than others which gets in the way with my purchasing. With a pack of 12, the birds won't have to wait for refills!

title: Smaller Than Expected
text: I am terrible about reading measurements on items before ordering. These storage containers are smaller than I expected, which is entirely on me. They're good containers. I can almost get one 3 pound bag of cat food spread over both containers. I often buy the 7 pound bags so when I do, there's no way I can get it into these. It is easier to pour than my previous container which was designed for cereal.

title: Bird Approved
text: I hung this up for the birds a few days ago. We have several bird feeders that we keep filled. This one doesn't have a hanger, but it does have a plastic piece that I was able to attach to an empty hanger that we had. It arrived mostly in tact with minimal loss of bird seed. It lasted a few days before it was emptied. Bird Approved! And possibly squirrel approved, too! We have a lot of them as well.

title: Cute Shape
text: I have 3 cats. One is overweight and another one eats fast and vomits a lot. I thought this might help with that. The food dish is shallow and has ridges inside. It almost looks like a maze except it doesn't go anywhere. The pictures are accurate as to what it looks like.  I was worried that the cats might not like eating from it, but they quickly adjusted. I was watching closely at the first time one of them was eating from it and with every bite, she seemed surprised. I'm not sure if it was because her whiskers were touching the ridges or what, but it didn't stop her from eating. She would take one piece out and put it on the floor next to her and then eat from there. We've only been using this bowl for a few days, but so far, so good!

title: Kitty Approved
text: I have 3 senior female kitties. They all have moments where they act young at heart. These cute bug toys definitely got them all being playful! The toys are well made and colorful. The cats seemed to think that they had a good amount of catnip in them. When I picked them up later, they were all soggy! These toys are approved by my kitties!

title: I'm Not Sure About This
text: I've had this set up in the laundry room where we have 2 of our litter boxes for over a week and I'm still not sure about this. It doesn't seem to be doing anything that I can see. I never see the light on. It doesn't make any noise. I can still smell the contents, but possibly lessened?  I do scoop out every day. It was easy to install and charge. I am expecting to get some kind of notification (a light?) telling me I need to recharge it.

title: Helps Bring Peace to Our Home
text: About a year ago, we adopted 2 senior girl kitties. We had an 8 year old cat (also female) already. I've been using these on and off for the last year. One of the new girls is very skittish, but she also bullies the others. Our original cat retaliates. I currently have one of these units in our bedroom and the other in the kitchen near their food. It does seem to help and bring peace to our home. It's not continuous, but the fighting and hissing is lessened. It is a bit pricey, so I don't always have the refills, but I try.

title: The Cats Seem to Be Okay with It
text: We have 3 cats and 5 litter boxes. Two of the boxes are Breeze ones and the other 3 are traditional ones. My cats do pretty well with switching litter and seem to be okay with this. I didn't notice much of a scent with this at all. We recently used plant based litter and that has a strong smell to it, so this was a pleasant change. I haven't noticed much dust from it either. The last brand name litter that we used (some "light weight" one), my cats were literally leaving dust prints all over the  house! I would see little cat prints on the table, clean laundry (dark) and more! I can't say for certain that this has good odor control. I do scoop daily - you have to with 3 cats! Also, when I don't, one of the kitties will start doing her business anywhere she pleases! Clumping is good - I've had better and worse.

title: The Birds Seem to Like It
text: This bell shaped bird bell arrived in a padded envelope without any additional padding. So naturally, it arrived in less than perfect condition. I would estimate that about a quarter of it was broken off and in crumbs. I poured that out on the ground near where we keep the bird feeders. It says it comes ready to hang, but it doesn't come with anything to hang it with. My husband took a piece of rope and tied it underneath the plastic part at the top and then hung it. The birds seem to like it!

title: My Cat LOVES This!
text: When this arrived, my husband said "great, another cat bed!" He was being sarcastic. We have 3 cats and lots of cat beds and cat condos and cat scratchers. I actually assembled this on my very own. I don't do things like that, so by telling you that, it means that it was easy to put together. Everything I needed was included. The directions were easy to follow and understand. One of my cats has pretty much claimed it as her own. The height is good and allows her to survey the room. The bed is big enough that she can stretch out. If you have cats that actually like each other and get along, you could probably get both of them in it. Right now it's in the living room and getting a lot of kitty use!

title: Cute!
text: This fancy cat collar is really cute! However, my cats might disagree with me on that. The color itself is well made. It has a tie closure. When I was putting it on one of my cats for the first time, the bell came right off. I will be able to reattach that, but I wasn't expecting that to happen. I won't be having my cats wear this for extended periods of time as it doesn't have a breakaway feature. So because of that, they will only wear it for short periods of time when they are fully supervised. I tried to take a picture of one of them wearing it, but no one would cooperate!

title: Kept the Dog Busy
text: We just fostered a dog over the Thanksgiving break as a way to temporarily get animals out of the shelter for a short time. My 19 year old daughter had dog responsibility. Even though she was on break for the week, she still had some assignments and projects to work on. She would give the dog one of these busy bones to give him something to do while she was working. He would lay on the floor by her feet and was occupied for a while. He seem to enjoy it and she appreciated the time to do her work.

title: Cute Kitty Bed
text: This is a super cute kitty bed! We have 3 cats and they love to be around the people. I have this set up in my home office for kitty naps. The cushion is very soft and one of my cats loves to knead on it. The green and pink color scheme is lovely. The toys that hang down from the top are securely attached, for now at least!

title: It Seems to Be Helping
text: We adopted a couple of senior kitties last year. So we went from 1 cat to 3 cats. We were told the 2 senior girls were bonded and from the same family, but after 1 year, we have seen no love between them. One of the girls is pretty chill. The other is very timid and shy. She's the one we've been having problems with. She attacks our first cat and bullies her. She does get bullied back at times, but we've witnessed her instigating most of it. We put the collar on her. She's had it on for about a week now. During that time, I have not heard any fighting. Usually I would hear a cat fight at least once a day. I have not heard any in the last week. My husband and I work at home and we're around most of the time. Now my original cat did end up with a scratch on her nose a few days ago which we assume was from the newbie. Other than that, I have not seen or heard any fighting. So it seems to be helping. It has an familiar scent to it and it's noticeable when I'm near the kitty who is wearing it. My cats already wear collars, so she didn't have any problem adjusting to it. It wasn't a cake walk putting it on her, but once it was one, it's been fine. If I continue to see improvement, I will be buying these monthly for sure!

title: Nice Height
text: I have raised dishes for my cats in their primary eating area in the kitchen. I also keep water for them upstairs. They were using just a regular bowl but I wanted a raised one for them. I  like this because it has a stainless steel bowl that is easy to remove for refilling. I take the bowl to the sink and rinse it out well before refilling. It is sturdy and we haven't had any issues with it getting knocked over.

title: Gets Rid of Smells
text: We have 3 cats and 4 litter boxes. You can probably imagine what they smell like. This spray has been helpful at getting rid of icky litter box smells. It's not long lasting, but it does work for a little while. The spray bottle is easy to use. I don't notice any scent from it so it's not covering up smells with a heavy fragrance.

title: Nice Collars
text: I have 3 cats. I wish I could say that they all got along well, but they don't. Collars have become an necessity. It prevents or at least reduces the number of sneak attacks. These collars are nice. I like the variety of bright colors. They breakaway well - I always have to test that feature. When their collars start to fade and look dull, I like to replace them with a bright new pretty one. These are a good value and will provide plenty of replacement collars for my girls when needed.

title: Great Place for Kitty!
text: We adopted 2 senior kitties last year. We already had 1 cat. The 3 girls aren't getting along as well as I had hoped. They pretty much all keep their distance from one another. I was looking for more kitty spots in our bedroom. Usually one cat will sleep on the bed. Another one will perch on the top of our multi-level kitty condo. Then a third one is on the floor somewhere. I wanted more options, so this fit the bill. It's a low, single level cat spot. It was very simple to put together. The cats all investigated it when it first appeared in the bedroom. I haven't seen anyone on or in it yet, but it's ready for someone. It's fairly sturdy and I think it would accommodate even my largest (18 pound) girl. Even if no one is using it yet, I'm sure it will be claimed eventually. It's there when kitties are ready.

title: Super Quiet
text: I have 3 cats and I have to frequently refill their water dishes. I thought it would be helpful to have another water dish for them to access. This was easy to set up and started working right away. I was surprised at how quiet it actually is!  It's been up and running for days now and I have not witnessed any of the cats drinking from it. That doesn't mean that they're ignoring it. I'm sure once they're used to it, they will drink from it. They have been caught staring at it.

title: Clumps Well
text: I have tried both the Unscented and this scented version of the barley Boxiecat Air litter. They both have wonderful clumping ability. I usually buy regular scoopable Tidy Cat and these clump much better than that. I wasn't much of a fan of the unscented one because the smell of the plant material is pretty strong, but this scented version is much more pleasant. My cats haven't had any trouble transitioning to this litter. We have 4 litter boxes and 3 cats. Two of the litter boxes are Breeze ones and those use special pellets. The other two are traditional boxes. I would consider using this again.

title: Easy to use
text: My cats all suffer from hairballs. I have been trying to brush them more frequently in an effort to help them digest less hair. This is a good pet brush. I really like how easy it is to clean the hair out of it. It's just a simple pressing of a button and that's it! My cats like the feel of the brush. I've caught one of my cats trying it use it when it was just sitting on the ottoman.

title: Great Odor Controll
text: I have 3 cats and 4 litter boxes. Two of the boxes are Breeze ones and the other 2 are traditional ones. I adopted 2 senior cats last year and I wanted them to have access to what they were used to for their business needs so that's why I still have traditional ones. My other cat had made the transition to the Breeze a couple of years ago, but every once in a while she'll use the traditional ones. After using these new pads/pellets for over a week now, I have been impressed with the improved odor control. Another thing I have noticed is that the pads are a little thicker and more absorbent. The old ones would have visible yellow areas where the urine soaked in. You can still see where the urine is on these, but it's much lighter in color which I assume is because they're thicker. Regardless, the smell is noticeably lesser than before.

title: Clumps Well!
text: I have 3 cats and 4 litter boxes. Two of the boxes are the Breeze systems and the other 2 are traditional. In the traditional ones, we usually use Tidy Cat. A few months ago, I switched the upstairs Tidy Cat with corn litter and I like that. I swapped the other traditional box with this. I started by completely cleaning out the box. Yuck!! It took the whole bag to fill the large pan. It has a strong plant smell to it which I am not crazy about. It's been several days and the smell is still pretty strong. It is doing a good job of covering the urine smell. I do really like the clumping that this does. It's the best clumping litter we've ever had. I am super impressed with that feature. This clumps better than the corn one, but in my opinion the corn litter smells better.  I'm noticing about the same amount of litter being tracked outside of the box. Oh, and none of my cats had any difficulties changing to this litter. That was pretty smooth. Now if only I could get all of them to properly cover their poo. I'm not sure if they're lazy or if they were never taught!

title: It's a Hit!
text: I have 3 senior kitties. These toys arrived a couple of days ago and I have seen all of them playing with them at one time or another. The coffee cup with the feather has gotten the most play, but both have been a hit with my girls! The toys are well made and sturdy. They've held up to excessive chewing, biting, and attacking during the short time they've been here. I would definitely recommend these to other cat families!

title: Great for Cat Space Missions!
text: Our 3 cats love cardboard scratchers! This one was immediately welcomed by all three. Assembly was easy and straight forward. It comes with Velcro strips to secure the corner pieces, kind of like zip ties. Of course, it also comes with a bag of catnip! The finished unit is really cute! The cardboard scratcher is the base of the space house. My largest kitty hasn't made her way into it, but the other two have been seen snoozing and playing inside. This is great for cat space missions!

title: Cute Design!
text: I have 3 cats. We recently got a small kitty condo with a hammock shelf that they enjoy, so I thought they might like having another hammock. The instructions were okay, but they refer to specific screws to go in certain places, but there's no way to know which screw. It says something like "screw #1" but the screws aren't labeled. They are 3 different screws so we had to guess. The hammock seems sturdy enough, but time will tell!  It does come with a screw driver, but my husband used his his cordless drill instead. The finished unit looks nice and has a modern look to it.

title: Good Quality Cat Food
text: My cats are older girls and they all eat a combination of wet food and dry food. This is a gravy style food. Sometimes i mix this with a tuna pate from the same brand to make it a little thicker. It's a good quality cat food. It does have the typical canned tuna cat food smell to it, but it's not too bad. 2 out of my 3 girls have eaten this and seem to enjoy it. The other one is Miss Picky and tends to eat only the same brand/flavor, but I have offered it to her.

title: My Picky Cats Sometimes Like It!
text: My cats are picky eaters. Sometimes they like this and sometimes they don't. There's no rhyme or reason (that I can tell) for their pickiness. They'll eat something one day and snub it the next. This is a quality cat food brand. There are only a few brands that they'll even eat, so that counts for something. It doesn't smell too bad. When they do eat it, they usually lick the bowl clean.

title: Kitty Approved
text: My cats love cardboard scratchers! We have several in our house. This one is a very nice looking one and looks like furniture. It does require some assembly. It comes with a screwdriver and extra screws to do the job. There are 2 different ways to put it together. We opted for the bed style. The kitties seem to like it. It's definitely getting used. It says that you can get replacement cardboard pieces for it, but I haven't been able to find them. I do like that idea. Cardboard scratchers do get too worn after a while. It does seem like a lot of work to take the wooden pieces off and put them onto a new one.
